entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The aarakocra casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)) At will:
  • Elementalism (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Exert control over the elements, creating one of the following effects within range. Beckon Air. You create a breeze strong enough to ripple cloth, stir dust, rustle leaves, and close open doors and shutters, all in a 5-foot Cube. Doors and shutters being held open by someone or something aren't affected. Beckon Earth. You create a thin shroud of dust or sand that covers surfaces in a 5-foot-square area, or you cause a single word to appear in your handwriting in a patch of dirt or sand. Beckon Fire. You create a thin cloud of harmless embers and colored, scented smoke in a 5-foot Cube. You choose the color and scent, and the embers can light candles, torches, or lamps in that area. The smoke's scent lingers for 1 minute. Beckon Water. You create a spray of cool mist that lightly dampens creatures and objects in a 5-foot Cube. Alternatively, you create 1 cup of clean water either in an open container or on a surface, and the water evaporates in 1 minute. Sculpt Element. You cause dirt, sand, fire, smoke, mist, or water that can fit in a 1-foot Cube to assume a crude shape (such as that of a creature) for 1 hour.
  • Gust of Wind (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, Self) Line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the duration. Each creature in the Line must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the Line. A creature that ends its turn in the Line must make the same Reaction Roll.Any creature in the Line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles and similar unprotected flames in the area. It causes protected flames, such as those of lanterns, to dance wildly and has a 50 percent chance to extinguish them.As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can change the direction in which the Line blasts from you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
1/day:
  • Lightning Bolt (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Self) Stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.description:
Reaction: The aarakocra is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14), +6 to hit with spell attacks). The aarakocra has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
5st level:
  • Cone of Cold (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Self) Unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The aartuk casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12)) 1/day:
  • Calm Emotions (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature):The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Sending (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Divination, Unlimited) Send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (15)) At will:
  • Detect Thoughts (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Self) Activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC, ending the spell on a success.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

Roll 1d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; or 4, west.2-6The target doesn't move or take actions.7-8The target doesn't move, and it takes the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. The target can act normally on its turn if you choose no creature or if no creature is within its reach. The target repeats the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success.On your later turns, you must take the Magic action to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.
  • Suggestion (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 8 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

entries.name: Insatiable Greed
entries.description: Passive: The abhorrent overlord can sense the presence of gold within 1,000 feet of itself. It can determine which location has the greatest amount of gold and can sense the direction to that site. If the gold is being moved, it knows the direction of the movement. It can't locate gold if any thickness of clay or lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between it and the gold.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The abhorrent overlord has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Storm of Crows (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1 ally, who appear at Far range.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Force Blast
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to each creature in a 20-foot cube originating from the abjurer must make a difficulty (16) constitution reaction roll. on a failed reaction roll, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the abjurer. on a successful reaction roll, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The abjurer casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16)) At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
2/day:
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Lightning Bolt (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Self) Stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.
  • Mage Armor (1st, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
1/day:
  • Arcane Lock (2nd, Action, Until dispelled, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch and magically lock it for the duration. This lock can't be unlocked by any non-magical means. You and any creatures you designate when you cast the spell can open and close the object despite the lock. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, unlocks it for 1 minute.
  • Banishment (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, 30 feet) One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.
  • Globe of Invulnerability (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Self) Immobile, shimmering barrier appears in a 10-foot Emanation around you and remains for the duration.Any spell of level 5 or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect anything within it. Such a spell can target creatures and objects within the barrier, but the spell has no effect on them. Similarly, the area within the barrier is excluded from areas of effect created by such spells.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Wall of Force (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 120 feet) Invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic. A Disintegrate spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Eldritch Restoration
entries.description: Passive: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its HP in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries.description: Reaction: If the aboleth fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Mucus Cloud
entries.description: Reaction: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. Constitution Reaction Roll: Difficulty (14), each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. Failure: The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain HP unless it is underwater.While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

entries.name: Probing Telepathy
entries.description: Passive: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Consume Memories
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to intelligence reaction roll: difficulty (16), one creature within 30 feet that is charmed or grappled by the aboleth. failure: 10 (3d6) psychic damage. success: half damage. failure or success: the aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a humanoid and is reduced to 0 hp by this action.

entries.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to wisdom reaction roll: difficulty (16), one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. failure: the target has the charmed condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. while charmed, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. in addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.the target repeats the reaction roll whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Lash
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the aboleth makes one tentacle attack.

entries.name: Psychic Drain
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to if the aboleth has at least one creature charmed or grappled, it uses consume memories and regains 5 (1d10) hp.

entries.name: Abolethic Vessel
entries.description: Passive: The spawn must obey its aboleth master.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The spawn can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Water Dependency
entries.description: Passive: The spawn takes 6 (1d12) acid damage every 10 minutes it goes without being immersed in water.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Fear of Fire
entries.description: Passive: If the yeti takes Fire damage, it has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (cold).

entries.name: Chilling Gaze
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to constitution reaction roll: difficulty (18), one creature the yeti can see within 30 feet. failure: 21 (6d6) cold damage, and the target has the paralyzed condition until the start of the yeti's next turn unless the target has immunity to cold damage. success: the target is immune to this yeti's chilling gaze for 1 hour.

entries.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale frost in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 10d8 cold damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Abyssal Chicken

entries.name: Bad Flier
entries.description: Passive: The abyssal chicken falls at the end of a turn if it's airborne and the only thing holding it aloft is its flying speed.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened, Corrupt

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d8+1 damage.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Passive: Acererak carries the Staff of the Forgotten One. He wears a Talisman of the Sphere and has a Sphere of Annihilation under his control.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Acererak fails a Reaction Roll, he can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries.description: Reaction: Acererak's body turns to dust when he drops to 0 HP, and his equipment is left behind. Acererak gains a new body after 1d10 days, regaining all his HP and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Acererak's phylactery, the location of which is hidden.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Acererak is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (23), +15 to hit with spell attacks). Acererak has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Ray of Frost (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
  • Shocking Grasp (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Touch) Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
9st level:
  • Power Word Kill (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Enchantment, 60 feet) Compel one creature you can see within range to die. If the target has 100 HP or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 12d12 Psychic damage.
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Acererak has a bonus on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 3 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 3d6 cold damage.

entries.name: Staff (+3 Quarterstaff)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+4 necrotic damage.

entries.name: Invoke Curse
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. While holding the Staff of the Forgotten One, Acererak expends 1 charge from it and targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a Difficulty (23) Constitution Reaction Roll or be cursed. Until the curse is ended, the target can't regain HP and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. Greater restoration, remove curse, or similar magic ends the curse on the target.

entries.name: At-Will Spell
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Acererak casts one of his at-will spells.

entries.name: Melee Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to acererak uses paralyzing touch or makes one melee attack with his staff.

entries.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Acererak fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a Difficulty (20) Wisdom Reaction Roll against this magic or become frightened for 1 minute. The frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target its immune to Acererak's gaze for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Talisman of the Sphere (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to acererak uses his talisman of the sphere to move the sphere of annihilation under his control up to 90 feet.

entries.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each creature within 20 feet of Acererak must make a Difficulty (20) Constitution Reaction Roll against this magic, taking 42 (12d6) necrotic damage on a failed Reaction Roll, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Adult Amethyst Dragon

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The dragon can breathe both air and water.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If the dragon fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (magic).

entries.name: Singularity Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Strength Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 10d8 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (18)) 1/day:
  • Blink (3rd, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, Self) Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration. On a roll of 4-6, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). While on the Ethereal Plane, you can perceive the plane you left, which is cast in shades of gray, but you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can affect and be affected only by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane, and creatures on the other plane can't perceive you unless they have a special ability that lets them perceive things on the Ethereal Plane.You return to the other plane at the start of your next turn and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane. You return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you left. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space.
  • Control Water (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 300 feet) Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one. Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing.The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts. Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored. Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Protection from Evil and Good (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Abjuration, Touch) Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have penalty on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has a bonus on any new Reaction Roll against the relevant effect.
  • Sending (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Divination, Unlimited) Send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The dragon magically transforms into any creature that is Medium or Small, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 HP or uses a bonus action to end it.

entries.name: Psychic Step
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The dragon magically teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of it.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the dragon makes one claw attack.

entries.name: Psionics (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The dragon uses Psychic Step or Spellcasting.

entries.name: Explosive Crystal (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range emanation. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d8 magic damage and have the Prone condition until the end of their next turn. Targets who succeed take half damage only.

motives_tactics: Hoard treasure, Dominate by force, Crush, Overwhelm

name: Adult Black Dragon

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The dragon can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries.description: Reaction: If the dragon fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (acid).

entries.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale acid in a Far range line. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 12d8 acid damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Fear (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, Self) Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends on that creature.
  • Melf's Acid Arrow (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 90 feet) Shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage and 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage only.
1/day:
  • Speak with Dead (3rd, Action, 10 minutes, Necromancy, 10 feet) Grant the semblance of life to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer questions you pose. The corpse must have a mouth, and this spell fails if the deceased creature was Undead when it died. The spell also fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the past 10 days.Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are antagonistic toward it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can't learn new information, doesn't comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can't speculate about future events.
  • Vitriolic Sphere (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 150 feet) Point at a location within range, and a glowing, 1-foot-diameter ball of acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, a creature takes 10d4 Acid damage and another 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half the initial damage only.

entries.name: Cloud of Insects
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to dexterity reaction roll: difficulty (17), one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. failure: 22 (4d10) poison damage, and the target has penalty on saving throws to maintain concentration until the end of its next turn. failure or success: the dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to Fear. The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Pounce
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the dragon can move up to half its speed, and it makes one rend attack.

motives_tactics: Hoard treasure, Dominate by force, Crush, Overwhelm

name: Adult Blue Dragon

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries.description: Reaction: If the dragon fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (18)) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Shatter (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Loud noise erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has penalty on the Reaction Roll.A non-magical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.
1/day:
  • Scrying (5th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, Self) Can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the Reaction Roll against, only that it feels uneasy.Your Knowledge of the Target Is...Reaction Roll ModifierSecondhand (heard of the target)+5Firsthand (met the target)+0Extensive (know the target well)-5You Have the Target's...Reaction Roll ModifierPicture or other likeness-2Garment or other possession-4Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail-10On a successful Reaction Roll, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.
  • Sending (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Divination, Unlimited) Send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.

  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
  • Scorching Ray (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one target within range or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage.
  • Shapechange (9th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Self) Shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can't be a Construct or an Undead.When you cast the spell, you gain a number of Temporary HP equal to the HP of the first form into which you shape-shift. These Temporary HP vanish if any remain when the spell ends.Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; HP; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.
  • Speak with Animals (1st, Action, 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.
1/day:
  • Detect Thoughts (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Self) Activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC, ending the spell on a success.
  • Control Weather (8th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 8 hours, Transmutation, Self) Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.PrecipitationStageCondition1Clear2Light clouds3Overcast or ground fog4Rain, hail, or snow5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzardTemperatureStageCondition1Heat wave2Hot3Warm4Cool5Cold6FreezingWindStageCondition1Calm2Moderate wind3Strong wind4Gale5Storm

The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0.The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (19), +11 to hit with spell attacks) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Hold Monster (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 90 feet) Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Ice Knife (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 60 feet) Create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 2d6 Cold damage.
  • Shapechange (9th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Self) Shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can't be a Construct or an Undead.When you cast the spell, you gain a number of Temporary HP equal to the HP of the first form into which you shape-shift. These Temporary HP vanish if any remain when the spell ends.Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; HP; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.
1/day:
  • Ice Storm (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 300 feet) Hail falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll. A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Hailstones turn ground in the Cylinder into Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.
  • Zone of Truth (2nd, Action, 10 minutes, Enchantment, 60 feet) Create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius. You know whether a creature succeeds or fails on this Reaction Roll.An affected creature is aware of the spell and can avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can be evasive yet must be truthful.

Whenever a target that fails this Reaction Roll makes an attack roll or a Reaction Roll before the spell ends, the target must subtract 1d4 from the attack roll or Reaction Roll.
  • Control Water (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 300 feet) Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic action on your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one. Flood. You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing.The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts. Part Water. You part water in the area and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell's area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored. Redirect Flow. You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell's area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. Whirlpool. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area, which must be at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. The whirlpool lasts until you choose a different effect or the spell ends. The whirlpool is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature in the water and within 25 feet of the whirlpool is pulled 10 feet toward it. When a creature enters the whirlpool for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, it makes a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 2d8 Bludgeoning damage. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature can swim away from the whirlpool only if it first takes an action to pull away and succeeds on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.
  • Create or Destroy Water (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Do one of the following:Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.

Unless the Reaction Roll succeeds, the creature rolls a d8 to determine what it does during the current turn:1-4: The creature is stunned until the end of the turn.5-6: The creature is frightened until the end of the turn and uses its movement to get as far as possible from the nullifier.7-8: The creature doesn't move, and it uses its action to make one melee attack against a random creature (other than itself) if one is within reach. It otherwise does nothing

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The nullifier's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16)). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Counterspell (3rd, Reaction, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 60 feet) Attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • See Invisibility (2nd, Action, 1 hour, Divination, Self) For the duration, you see creatures and objects that have the Invisible condition as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Creatures and objects there appear ghostly.
1/day:
  • Antimagic Field (8th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Aura of antimagic surrounds you in a 10-foot Emanation. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can't target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don't work inside the aura or on anything inside it.Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can't extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura.Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn't function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.Dispel Magic has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don't nullify each other.

The object is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. It isn't pushed with enough force to cause damage.You create a harmless sensory effect using air, such as causing leaves to rustle, wind to slam shutters closed, or your clothing to ripple in a breeze.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

Reaction: Afsoun is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks). Afsoun can cast disguise self and invisibility At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.

On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
9st level:
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

entries.name: Ethereal Sight

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 4d6+3 necrotic damage.

entries.name: Etherealness
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to agony enters the ethereal plane from the material plane, or vice versa. it is visible on the material plane while it is in the border ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Agony that can see it must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One humanoid that Agony can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Charisma Reaction Roll or be possessed by Agony; Agony then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Agony now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Agony can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Agony ends it as a bonus action, or Agony is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

entries.description:
Reaction: Al'chaia's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
3/day:
  • Jump (1st, Bonus, 1 minute, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
  • Misty Step (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
  • Nondetection (3rd, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
  • Tongues (3rd, Action, 1 hour, Divination, Touch) Grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.
1/day:
  • Plane Shift (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Touch) And up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the DM.Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.
  • Telekinesis (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) Gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell. Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the Reaction Roll. Object. You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Alax casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)) At will:
  • Druidcraft (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.
  • Resistance (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.
1/day:
  • Cure Wounds (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Creature you touch regains a number of HP equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Purify Food and Drink (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation (ritual), 10 feet) Remove poison and rot from non-magical food and drink in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range.
