The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The greatwyrm casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (26), +18 to hit with spell attack) 1/day:
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Forcecage (7th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Evocation, 100 feet) Immobile, Invisible, Cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.A prison in the shape of a cage can be up to 20 feet on a side and is made from 1/2-inch diameter bars spaced 1/2 inch apart. A prison in the shape of a box can be up to 10 feet on a side, creating a solid barrier that prevents any matter from passing through it and blocking any spells cast into or out from the area.When you cast the spell, any creature that is completely inside the cage's area is trapped. Creatures only partially within the area, or those too large to fit inside it, are pushed away from the center of the area until they are completely outside it.A creature inside the cage can't leave it by non-magical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to leave, it must first make a Charisma Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature can use that magic to exit the cage. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature doesn't exit the cage and wastes the spell or effect. The cage also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel.This spell can't be dispelled by Dispel Magic.
  • Plane Shift (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Touch) And up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the DM.Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.
  • Reverse Gravity (7th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Transmutation, 100 feet) Reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high Cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects in that area that aren't anchored to the ground fall upward and reach the top of the Cylinder. A creature can make a Dexterity Reaction Roll to grab a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall upward.If a ceiling or an anchored object is encountered in this upward fall, creatures and objects strike it just as they would during a downward fall. If an affected creature or object reaches the Cylinder's top without striking anything, it hovers there for the duration. When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall downward.
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
2/day:
  • Charm Person (1st, Action, 1 hour, Enchantment, 30 feet) One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. It does so with a bonus if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Armor (1st, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
  • Hold Person (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Suggestion (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 8 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.
  • Tongues (3rd, Action, 1 hour, Divination, Touch) Grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.

If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.

The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. The DM chooses the omen from the Omens table.OmensOmenFor Results That Will Be...WealGoodWoeBadWeal and woeGood and badIndifferenceNeither good nor badThe spell doesn't account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results.If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Mending (Cantrip, 1 Min., Instantaneous, Transmutation, Touch) Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
1st level:
  • Burning Hands (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Self) Thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
  • Disguise Self (1st, Action, 1 hour, Illusion, Self) Make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.
  • Shield (1st, Reaction, 1 round, Abjuration, Self) Imperceptible barrier of magical force protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

entries.description: Reaction: Enna Galakiir deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has a bonus on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Enna Galakiir that isn't incapacitated and Enna Galakiir doesn't have penalty on the attack roll.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Assassinate
entries.description: Passive: During its first turn, Enna Galakiir has a bonus on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Enna Galakiir scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: Reaction: If Enna Galakiir is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity Reaction Roll to take only half damage, Enna Galakiir instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the Reaction Roll, and only half damage if it fails.

entries.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries.description: Reaction: Enna Galakiir deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has a bonus on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Enna Galakiir that isn't incapacitated and Enna Galakiir doesn't have penalty on the attack roll.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Reach
entries.description: Passive: The tentacle can reach anywhere in the room.

entries.name: Constrict
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 2d8+4 damage and becomes *Restrained*.

entries.name: Trampling Charge
entries.description: Reaction: If Envy moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a Difficulty (16) Strength Reaction Roll or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Envy can make one attack with its claws against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 2d12+5 damage.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 2d10+5 damage.

entries.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage (magic) and have the Restrained condition until the end of their next turn.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Headfirst Charge
entries.description: Reaction: If the equinal moves at least 30 feet in a straight line toward a creature and ends within 5 feet of it, that creature must succeed on a Difficulty (17) Strength Reaction Roll or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and have the prone condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (radiant).

entries.name: Shout (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the equinal lets out a booming shout. each creature within 30 feet of the equinal must succeed on a difficulty (14) constitution reaction roll or have the stunned condition until the end of the equinal's next turn.

entries.name: Diabolical Restoration
entries.description: Passive: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its HP somewhere in the Nine Hells.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The erinyes has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Rope
entries.description: Reaction: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 HP, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to strength reaction roll: difficulty (16), one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. failure: 14 (4d6) force damage, and the target has the restrained condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a bonus action to release the target, or the erinyes uses entangling rope again.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The acolyte is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12), +4 to hit with spell attacks). The acolyte has following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
1st level:
  • Bless (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 30 feet) Bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a Reaction Roll before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or Reaction Roll.
  • Cure Wounds (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Creature you touch regains a number of HP equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
  • Sanctuary (1st, Bonus, 1 minute, Abjuration, 30 feet) Ward a creature within range. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack roll or a damaging spell must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or either choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This spell doesn't protect the warded creature from areas of effect.The spell ends if the warded creature makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.

entries.name: Club
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4 damage.

entries.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead (1/Short Rest)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to erky presents his holy symbol and speaks a prayer censuring the undead. each undead that can see or hear erky within 30 feet of him must make a difficulty (12) wisdom reaction roll. if the creature fails its reaction roll, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.a turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from erky as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of him. it also can't take reactions. for its action, it can use only the dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. if there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the dodge action.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Acid Rain (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to use this ability in a Far range emanation. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 4d10 acid damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Ervan casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14)) At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
2/day:
  • Dimension Door (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 500 feet) Teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.
1/day:
  • Disguise Self (1st, Action, 1 hour, Illusion, Self) Make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
  • Mage Armor (1st, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Escher regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Escher takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Escher's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Escher can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries.description: Reaction: Escher has the following flaws:Forbiddance. Escher can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.Harmed by Running Water. Escher takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.Stake to the Heart. Escher is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place.Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Escher takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Bioluminescence
entries.description: Passive: While it has at least 1 hit point, the esthetic sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet, and its interior compartments are dimly lit.

entries.name: Spelljamming
entries.description: Passive: The esthetic has the properties of a spelljamming helm (see the Astral Adventurer's Guide), but only its reigar creator can attune to it.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The esthetic doesn't require air, food, or drink.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Jammerscream (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The esthetic targets one spelljamming ship within 300 feet of itself, magically suppressing the properties of the ship's spelljamming helm for 2d10 days. If the ship has more than one helm aboard it, randomly determine which helm is affected. A creature attuned to that helm can choose to make a Difficulty (17) Charisma Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 42 (12d6) psychic damage, and the helm is suppressed for 2d10 hours instead of 2d10 days. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage, and the helm is suppressed for 2d10 minutes instead of 2d10 days.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Flaming Weapon (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: Passive: As a bonus action, the guard can wreath one melee weapon it is wielding in flame. The guard is unharmed by this fire, which lasts until the end of the guard's next turn. While wreathed in flame, the weapon deals an extra 3 (1d6) fire damage on a hit.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The priest is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells At will:
  • Control Flames (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous or 1 hour (see below), Transmutation, 60 feet) Choose non-magical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube. You affect it in one of the following ways:You instantaneously expand the flame 5 feet in one direction, provided that wood or other fuel is present in the new location.You instantaneously extinguish the flames within the cube.You double or halve the area of bright light and dim light cast by the flame, change its color, or both. The change lasts for 1 hour.You cause simple shapes—such as the vague form of a creature, an inanimate object, or a location—to appear within the flames and animate as you like. The shapes last for 1 hour.If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three non-instantaneous effects created by it active at a time, and you can dismiss such an effect as an action.
  • Create Bonfire (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Conjuration, 60 feet) Create a bonfire on ground that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the magic bonfire fills a 5-foot cube. Any creature in the bonfire's space when you cast the spell must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 fire damage. A creature must also make the Reaction Roll when it moves into the bonfire's space for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.The bonfire ignites flammable objects in its area that aren't being worn or carried.The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
3st level:
  • Fireball (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 150 feet) Bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

name: Ettercap

entries.name: Web Walker
entries.description: Passive: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Web Strand (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to dexterity reaction roll: difficulty (12), one large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. failure: the target has the restrained condition until the web is destroyed (ac 10; hp 5; vulnerability to fire damage; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

entries.name: Reel
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is restrained by its web strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Euryale fails a Reaction Roll, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Medusa Form Only)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Euryale casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (19)) At will:
  • Druidcraft (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.
  • Pass without Trace (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
2/day:
  • Goodberry (1st, Action, 24 hours, Conjuration, Touch) Ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 Hit Point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day.Uneaten berries disappear when the spell ends.
  • Lesser Restoration (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
  • Locate Creature (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Divination, Self) Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location if that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.The spell can locate a specific creature known to you or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn) if you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once. If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as under the effects of a Flesh to Stone or Polymorph spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature.This spell can't locate a creature if any thickness of lead blocks a direct path between you and the creature.
  • Move Earth (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 2 hours, Transmutation, 120 feet) Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can't exceed half the area's largest dimension. For example, if you affect a 40-foot square, you can create a pillar up to 20 feet high, raise or lower the square's elevation by up to 20 feet, dig a trench up to 20 feet deep, and so on. It takes 10 minutes for these changes to complete. Because the terrain's transformation occurs slowly, creatures in the area can't usually be trapped or injured by the ground's movement.At the end of every 10 minutes you spend Concentrating on the spell, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect within range.This spell can't manipulate natural stone or stone construction. Rocks and structures shift to accommodate the new terrain. If the way you shape the terrain would make a structure unstable, it might collapse.Similarly, this spell doesn't directly affect plant growth. The moved earth carries any plants along with it.
  • Transport via Plants (6th, Action, 10 minutes, Conjuration, 10 feet) Creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before. For the duration, any creature can step into the target plant and exit from the destination plant by using 5 feet of movement.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to euryale changes shape into her huge serpent form or back into her medium medusa form. euryale's game statistics are the same in each form except where noted in this stat block. any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. euryale reverts to her medusa form if she dies.

On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.

The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if the Beast can fly.When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.

The target's attacks with its reduced weapons or Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 less damage on a hit (this can't reduce the damage below 1).
  • Fly (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
  • Suggestion (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 8 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

entries.name: Commanding Words
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The shaker speaks magical words to order a creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a Difficulty (14) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be affected by one of the following effects (choose one or roll a d4):1-2: Grovel. The target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage, drops whatever it is holding, and has the prone condition.3-4: Cower. The target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and has the frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Shapechanger (2/Day)
entries.description: Passive: The fathomer can use its action to polymorph into a Medium serpent composed of water, or back into its true form. Anything the fathomer is wearing or carrying is subsumed into the serpent form during the change, inaccessible until the fathomer returns to its true form. The fathomer reverts to its true form after 4 hours, unless it can expend another use of this trait. If the fathomer is knocked unconscious or dies, it also reverts to its true form.While in serpent form, the fathomer gains a swimming speed of 40 feet, the ability to breathe underwater, immunity to poison damage, as well as resistance to fire damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from non-magical attacks. It also has immunity to the following conditions: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, restrained, prone, unconscious. The serpent form can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if water can pass through a space, the serpent can do so without squeezing.

entries.name: Olhydra's Armor (Human Form Only)
entries.description: Passive: The fathomer can cast mage armor at will, without expending material components.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Human Form Only)
entries.description:
Reaction: The fathomer is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12), +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has two 3rd-level spell slots, which it regains after finishing a short or long rest, and knows the following warlock spells 3st level:
  • Armor of Agathys (1st, Bonus, 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Protective magical frost surrounds you. You gain 5 Temporary HP. If a creature hits you with a melee attack roll before the spell ends, the creature takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary HP.
  • Expeditious Retreat (1st, Bonus, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Self) Take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.
  • Hex (1st, Bonus, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Enchantment, 90 feet) Place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has penalty on ability checks made with the chosen ability.If the target drops to 0 HP before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Vampiric Touch (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Necromancy, Self) Touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain HP equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.Until the spell ends, you can make the attack again on each of your turns as a Magic action, targeting the same creature or a different one.

entries.name: Constrict (Serpent Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 2d6+2 damage and becomes *Restrained*.

entries.name: Dagger (Human Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+2 damage.

entries.name: Angelic Weapons
entries.description: Reaction: Fazrian's weapon attacks are magical. When Fazrian hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

entries.name: Divine Awareness
entries.description: Passive: Fazrian knows if it hears a lie.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Fazrian's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (20)). Fazrian can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Detect Evil and Good (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, Self) For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the Hallow spell is active there and, if so, where.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
3/day:
  • Blade Barrier (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 90 feet) Create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain.Any creature in the wall's space makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that Reaction Roll if it enters the wall's space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that Reaction Roll only once per turn.
  • Dispel Evil and Good (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Self) For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have penalty on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the Charmed or Frightened condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures. Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be sent back to its home plane if it isn't there already. If they aren't on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.
  • Flame Strike (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.
  • Raise Dead (5th, 1 Hr., Instantaneous, Necromancy, Touch) With a touch, you revive a dead creature if it has been dead no longer than 10 days and it wasn't Undead when it died.The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death.This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn't restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails.Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a -4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.
1/day:
  • Commune (5th, 1 Min., 1 minute, Divination (ritual), Self) Contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
  • Control Weather (8th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 8 hours, Transmutation, Self) Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.PrecipitationStageCondition1Clear2Light clouds3Overcast or ground fog4Rain, hail, or snow5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzardTemperatureStageCondition1Heat wave2Hot3Warm4Cool5Cold6FreezingWindStageCondition1Calm2Moderate wind3Strong wind4Gale5Storm
  • Insect Plague (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, 300 feet) Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The Sphere remains for the duration, and its area is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain.When the swarm appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 4d10 Piercing damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this Reaction Roll when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Fazrian has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (radiant).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The knight is a 1st-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12), +4 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spell At will:
  • Gust (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range:One Medium or smaller creature that you choose must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be pushed up to 5 feet away from you.You create a small blast of air capable of moving one object that is neither held nor carried and that weighs no more than 5 pounds. The object is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. It isn't pushed with enough force to cause damage.You create a harmless sensory effect using air, such as causing leaves to rustle, wind to slam shutters closed, or your clothing to ripple in a breeze.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Ray of Frost (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
1st level:
  • Expeditious Retreat (1st, Bonus, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Self) Take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.
  • Feather Fall (1st, Reaction, 1 minute, Transmutation, 60 feet) Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Dark Devotion
entries.description: Passive: Fel has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Fel is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (11), +3 to hit with spell attacks). Fel has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
2st level:
  • Hold Person (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Spiritual Weapon (2nd, Bonus, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Create a floating, spectral force that resembles a weapon of your choice and lasts for the duration. The force appears within range in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of the force. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the force up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Fel'rekt has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Fel'rekt to sleep.

entries.name: Gunslinger
entries.description: Reaction: Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature or attacking at long range doesn't impose penalty on Fel'rekt's ranged attack rolls with a pistol. In addition, Fel'rekt ignores half cover and three-quarters cover when making ranged attacks with a pistol.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Fel'rekt's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12)) It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
1/day:
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, Fel'rekt has penalty on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: Passive: The felbarren dwarf has a bonus on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+1 damage.

name: Felgolos

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: Felgolos can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Felgolos fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to each creature of felgolos's choice that is within 120 feet of felgolos and aware of it must succeed on a difficulty (17) wisdom reaction roll or become frightened for 1 minute. a creature can repeat the reaction roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. if a creature's reaction roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to felgolos's frightful presence for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to exhale destructive energy in a Far range cone. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 12d10 lightning damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Felgolos magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Felgolos's choice).In a new form, Felgolos retains its alignment, HP, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to felgolos makes a wisdom (perception) check.

entries.name: Tail Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to felgolos makes a tail attack.

entries.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to felgolos beats its wings. each creature within 10 feet of felgolos must succeed on a difficulty (20) dexterity reaction roll or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. felgolos can then fly up to half its flying speed.

motives_tactics: Hoard treasure, Dominate by force, Crush, Overwhelm

entries.name: Bonding
entries.description: Action: The felidar can magically bond with one creature it can see, right after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the felidar bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. This bond has the following effects: The felidar and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet. The felidar can sense the direction and distance to the bonded creature if they're on the same plane of existence. As an action, the felidar or the bonded creature can sense what the other sees and hears, during which time it loses its own sight and hearing. This effect lasts until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries.description: Passive: The felidar has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Pounce
entries.description: Reaction: If the felidar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a Difficulty (15) Strength Reaction Roll or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the felidar can make one claw attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

name: Female Steeder

entries.name: Extraordinary Leap
entries.description: Action: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to move 3 feet.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 1d8+3 poison damage.

entries.name: Sticky Leg
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes the standard attack damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened

entries.name: Reckless
entries.description: Passive: At the start of its turn, Fennor can gain bonus on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Death Curse
entries.description: Reaction: When the fensir starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate, it releases a curse on those around it. Each creature within 30 feet of the fensir when it dies must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Charisma Reaction Roll or be cursed for the next 24 hours.While cursed in this way, an affected creature gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Charisma Reaction Roll or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: The fensir regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries.description: Reaction: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a Difficulty (15) Constitution Reaction Roll or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: The fensir regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight. If the fensir takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the fensir's next turn. The fensir dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries.description: Reaction: When the fensir starts its turn in sunlight, it must succeed on a Difficulty (15) Constitution Reaction Roll or have the petrified condition until the fensir is no longer in sunlight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Mud to Stone (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The fensir lobs a magical mass of mud that splashes all creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point the fensir can see within 60 feet of itself. Each non-fensir creature in that area must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and have the restrained condition as the mud begins to turn to stone. An affected creature must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the effect ends on the creature. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature has the petrified condition for 24 hours.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The fensir casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability 1/day:
  • Create or Destroy Water (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Do one of the following:Create Water. You create up to 10 gallons of clean water within range in an open container. Alternatively, the water falls as rain in a 30-foot Cube within range, extinguishing exposed flames there.Destroy Water. You destroy up to 10 gallons of water in an open container within range. Alternatively, you destroy fog in a 30-foot Cube within range.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Pass without Trace (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: Fenthaza can use its action to polymorph into a Medium snake or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. If it dies, it stays in its current form.

entries.name: Death Fangs (2/Day)
entries.description: Passive: The first time Fenthaza hits with a melee attack on its turn, it can deal an extra 16 (3d10) necrotic damage to the target.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Fenthaza has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only)
entries.description:
Reaction: Fenthaza's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)). Fenthaza can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Animal Friendship (1st, Action, 24 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends.
3/day:

Reaction: Fenthaza is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It regains its expended spell slots when it finishes a short or long rest. It knows the following warlock spells 3st level:

Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, a target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, a target takes half as much damage only.

Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Fear (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, Self) Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends on that creature.
  • Hex (1st, Bonus, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Enchantment, 90 feet) Place a curse on a creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. The target has penalty on ability checks made with the chosen ability.If the target drops to 0 HP before this spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action on a later turn to curse a new creature.
  • Hold Person (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Hunger of Hadar (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Conjuration, 150 feet) Open a gateway to the Far Realm, a region infested with unspeakable horrors. A 20-foot-radius Sphere of Darkness appears, centered on a point with range and lasting for the duration. The Sphere is Difficult Terrain, and it is filled with strange whispers and slurping noises, which can be heard up to 30 feet away. No light, magical or otherwise, can illuminate the area, and creatures fully within it have the Blinded condition.Any creature that starts its turn in the area takes 2d6 Cold damage. Any creature that ends its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 2d6 Acid damage from otherworldly tentacles.
  • Witch Bolt (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Beam of crackling energy lances toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage.On each of your subsequent turns, you can take a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically, even if the first attack missed.The spell ends if the target is ever outside the spell's range or if it has Total Cover from you.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Fidelio that can see it must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One humanoid that Fidelio can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Charisma Reaction Roll or be possessed by Fidelio; Fidelio then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Fidelio now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Fidelio can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Fidelio ends it as a bonus action, or Fidelio is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Fidelio reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. 1/day:
