entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Far range. Targets this adversary succeeds against take the standard attack damage.

entries.name: Web Snare
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes the standard attack poison damage and becomes *Restrained*.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (fire).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Kala is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12), +4 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following druid spells prepared At will:
  • Druidcraft (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.
  • Produce Flame (Cantrip, Bonus, 10 minutes, Conjuration, Self) Flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there for the duration. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again.Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.
  • Shillelagh (Cantrip, Bonus, 1 minute, Transmutation, Self) Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. If the attack deals damage, it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon.
2st level:
  • Animal Messenger (2nd, Action, 24 hours, Enchantment (ritual), 30 feet) Tiny Beast of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll, or it attempts to deliver a message for you (if the target's Challenge Rating isn't 0, it automatically succeeds). You specify a location you have visited and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a person dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also communicate a message of up to twenty-five words. The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if the Beast can fly.When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.
  • Barkskin (2nd, Bonus, 1 hour, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin assumes a bark-like appearance, and the target has an Armor Class of 17 if its AC is lower than that.

entries.name: Quarterstaff
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Art Imitates Life (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: Kalain touches one of her paintings and causes its subject to spring forth, becoming a creature of that kind provided its CR is 3 or lower. The creature appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the painting, which becomes blank. The creature is friendly toward Kalain and hostile toward all others. It rolls initiative to determine when it acts. It disappears after 1 minute, when it is reduced to 0 HP, or when Kalain dies or falls unconscious.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Kalain has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed and magic can't put her to sleep.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Kalain is a 4th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma. She has the following bard spells prepared At will:
  • Friends (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 10 feet) Magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Vicious Mockery (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Enchantment, 60 feet) Unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at one creature you can see or hear within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have penalty on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
2st level:
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Shatter (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Loud noise erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has penalty on the Reaction Roll.A non-magical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

entries.name: Taunt (2/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: Kalain can use a bonus action on her turn to target one creature within 30 feet of it. If the target can hear Kalain, the target must succeed on a Difficulty (12) Charisma Reaction Roll or have penalty on ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws until the start of Kalain's next turn.

entries.name: Shortsword
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+2 damage.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+2 damage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: All-Around Vision
entries.description: Passive: The quori can't be surprised while it isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries.description: Action: The quori can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
Reaction: The quori's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (21), +13 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components At will:
  • Arcane Eye (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Divination, 30 feet) Create an Invisible, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which can see in every direction. It also has Darkvision with a range of 30 feet.As a Bonus Action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.
3/day:
  • Clairvoyance (3rd, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, 1 mile) Create an Invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The intangible, invulnerable sensor remains in place for the duration.When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As a Bonus Action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.A creature that sees the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from See Invisibility or Truesight) sees a luminous orb about the size of your fist.
  • Confusion (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 90 feet) Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll, or that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn, consulting the table below.1d10Behavior for the Turn1The target doesn't take an action, and it uses all its movement to move. Roll 1d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; or 4, west.2-6The target doesn't move or take actions.7-8The target doesn't move, and it takes the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If none are within reach, the target takes no action.9-10The target chooses its behavior.At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Dream (5th, 1 Min., 8 hours, Illusion, Self) Target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target's dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the spell's duration. The messenger can also shape the dream's environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking.If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams.You can make the messenger terrifying to the target. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words, and then the target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.
  • Eyebite (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Necromancy, Self) For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration.On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to target another creature but can't target a creature again if it has succeeded on a Reaction Roll against this casting of the spell. Asleep. The target has the Unconscious condition. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake. Panicked. The target has the Frightened condition. On each of its turns, the Frightened target must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the target moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can't see you, this effect ends. Sickened. The target has the Poisoned condition.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The quori has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Mind Seed (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The quori touches one humanoid, which must succeed on a Difficulty (21) Intelligence Reaction Roll or be cursed. The curse lasts until it's removed by a remove curse or greater restoration spell.The cursed target suffers 1 level of exhaustion every 24 hours, and finishing a long rest doesn't reduce its exhaustion. If the cursed target reaches exhaustion level 6, it doesn't die; it instead becomes a thrall under the quori's control, and all its exhaustion is removed. Only the wish spell can free the thrall from this control.

entries.name: Swarm of Eyes (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range emanation. All targets within that area must make Presence Reaction Roll (21). Targets who fail take 10d8 psychic damage and have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn. Targets who succeed take half damage only.

entries.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One humanoid that the quori can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Difficulty (21) Charisma Reaction Roll or be possessed by the quori; the quori then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. The quori now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The quori can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, the quori ends it as a bonus action, or the quori is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the quori reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this quori's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

entries.name: Dual Mind
entries.description: Passive: The kalashtar has a bonus on Wisdom saving throws.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+2 damage.

entries.name: Mind Thrust
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to the kalashtar targets a creature it can see within 30 feet of it. the target must succeed on a difficulty (12) wisdom reaction roll or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: Kalka-Kylla can breathe air and water.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries.description: Passive: While Kalka-Kylla remains motionless and hidden in its shell, it is indistinguishable from a polished boulder.

entries.name: Shell
entries.description: Action: Kalka-Kylla can use a bonus action to retract into or emerge from its shell. While retracted, Kalka-Kylla gains a +4 bonus to AC, and it has a speed of 0 and can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries.description: Passive: The kamadan has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Pounce
entries.description: Reaction: If the kamadan moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn that target must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Strength Reaction Roll or be knocked prone. If the target is knocked prone, the kamadan can make two attacks—one with its bite and one with its snakes—against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Sleep Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (12). Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Reaction: Kansaldi has a glowing ruby embedded in her left eye socket. The gem functions as her eye and grants her truesight (included above). The gem can't be removed while Kansaldi is alive. When she dies, a creature can remove the gem as an action. The gem then functions as a gem of seeing.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (radiant).

entries.name: Flame Burst
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Kansaldi hurls magical flames at a creature she can see within 60 feet of herself. The target must make a Difficulty (16) Dexterity Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target takes 11 (2d10) fire damage and catches fire; until a creature takes an action to put out the fire, the target takes 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage and doesn't catch fire.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Kansaldi casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16)) At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Spare the Dying (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 15 feet) Choose a creature within range that has 0 HP and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
1/day:
  • Blade Barrier (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 90 feet) Create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain.Any creature in the wall's space makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that Reaction Roll if it enters the wall's space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that Reaction Roll only once per turn.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Flame Strike (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.
  • Lesser Restoration (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
  • Revivify (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, Touch) Touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

entries.name: Dragon Queen's Favor
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Kansaldi or one creature she can see within 60 feet of herself magically regains 17 (2d12 + 4) HP.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Death Throes
entries.description: Reaction: When the draconian is reduced to 0 HP, it dissolves into acid that splashes on those around it. Each creature within 5 feet of the draconian must succeed on a Difficulty (12) Dexterity Reaction Roll or be covered in acid for 1 minute. A creature covered in the acid takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use its action to scrape or wash the acid off itself or another creature.

entries.name: Glide
entries.description: Reaction: When the draconian falls and isn't incapacitated, it subtracts up to 100 feet from the fall when calculating the fall's damage, and it can move up to 2 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it descends.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: Reaction: If Karas is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity Reaction Roll to take only half damage, Karas instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the Reaction Roll and only half damage if she fails. She can't use this trait if she has the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day or 4/Day in Lair)
entries.description: Reaction: If Karas fails a Reaction Roll, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Withdraw
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to karas moves up to half her speed without provoking opportunity attack action and takes the hide action.

entries.name: Harrow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to wisdom reaction roll: difficulty (15), one creature karas can see within 90 feet of herself. failure: 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the target has the frightened condition for 1 minute. while frightened, the target's speed is 0 feet, and it repeats the reaction roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. failure or success: karas can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

entries.name: Stealth Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to karas makes one dread dagger attack and uses withdraw.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Karavarix fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: Karavarix doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Cataclysmic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a Medium range cone. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 10d8 necrotic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to karavarix makes one claw attack.

entries.name: Cataclysmic Rush (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to karavarix moves up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks, carrying with it any creatures it is grappling. during this move, if it enters the space of a medium or smaller creature, that creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. a creature can take this damage only once per turn.

name: Karkethzerethzerus, the Sable Despoiler

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If the dragon fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Living Shadow
entries.description: Action: While in dim light or darkness, the dragon has resistance to damage that isn't force, psychic, or radiant.

entries.name: Shadow Stealth
entries.description: Passive: While in dim light or darkness, the dragon can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, the dragon has penalty on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 3 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a difficulty (21) wisdom reaction roll or become frightened for 1 minute. a creature can repeat the reaction roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. if a creature's reaction roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's frightful presence for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (24). Targets who fail take 15d8 necrotic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The dragon magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than its own, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the dragon's choice).In a new form, the dragon retains its alignment, HP, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. Its statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries.name: Detect
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the dragon makes a wisdom (perception) check.

entries.name: Tail Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the dragon makes a tail attack.

entries.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the dragon beats its wings. each creature within 15 feet of the dragon must succeed on a difficulty (25) dexterity reaction roll or take 17 (2d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. the dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

motives_tactics: Hoard treasure, Dominate by force, Crush, Overwhelm

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: Passive: The soldier has a bonus on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the soldier's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: Reaction: If damage reduces the soldier to 0 HP, it must make a Constitution Reaction Roll with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the soldier drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Passive: Kas wears the Crown of Lies (see the Introduction of Vecna: Eve of Ruin).

entries.name: Eager Betrayer
entries.description: Passive: Kas adds 1d10 to his initiative rolls. He has a bonus on attack rolls against any creature that has the frightened condition.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Kas fails a Reaction Roll, he can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Kas regains 20 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Kas can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Strength of the Night
entries.description: Passive: Kas doesn't require a coffin, and he drinks blood to sow terror rather than for sustenance. If destroyed, Kas revives in 1d100 nights in an unoccupied space in Tovag, his Domain of Dread. He can be permanently destroyed only by having a stake driven through his heart and then being beheaded. The stake must be cut from a tree growing in soil from Oerth, Kas's home world.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, Kas takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 3 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Kas transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Kas has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Kas can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. Kas has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all non-magical damage except the damage he takes as part of his Vampire Weaknesses trait. While in mist form, Kas can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

entries.name: Menacing Glare

The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If Kaylan isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.While in bat form, Kaylan can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.While in mist form, Kaylan can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all non-magical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Kaylan fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description: Reaction: When it drops to 0 HP outside its resting place, Kaylan transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.While it has 0 HP in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 HP, it regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Kaylan regains 20 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Kaylan takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Kaylan's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses

Kaylan takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Kaylan's heart while Kaylan is incapacitated in its resting place, Kaylan is paralyzed until the stake is removed.Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Kaylan takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks.

The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Kaylan and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Kaylan dies, or until Kaylan dismisses them as a bonus action.

This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Kedjou expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

entries.description:
Reaction: Kedjou is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). Kedjou has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.

If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation, and whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, the creature must make a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 Necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.

The target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the Reaction Roll against, only that it feels uneasy.Your Knowledge of the Target Is...Reaction Roll ModifierSecondhand (heard of the target)+5Firsthand (met the target)+0Extensive (know the target well)-5You Have the Target's...Reaction Roll ModifierPicture or other likeness-2Garment or other possession-4Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail-10On a successful Reaction Roll, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Hoopak
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+3 damage.

entries.name: Taunt
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the kender launches a barrage of insults at a creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. if the target can hear the kender, the target must succeed on a difficulty (12) wisdom reaction roll or have penalty on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Elusive
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the kender takes the disengage or hide action.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries.description: Passive: The kenku can mimic any sounds it has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Difficulty (14) Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries.name: Shadow Blade
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+3 necrotic damage.

entries.name: Eldritch Lantern (Recharge 4–6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The kenku casts Faerie Fire, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (10)).

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Ker-arach has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Ker-arach can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Web Walker
entries.description: Passive: Ker-arach ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Spiderling Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take 6d10 poison damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Stifling Webs (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to ker-arach spins a 30-foot cube of strong, sticky webbing in an area adjacent to itself. the webbing lasts for 1 minute, is difficult terrain, and lightly obscures its area. a creature that starts its turn in the webbing or enters the webbing for the first time on its turn must succeed on a difficulty (15) dexterity reaction roll or have the restrained condition while in the web. as an action, a creature can free itself or another creature from the web by succeeding on a difficulty (15) strength check.a 5-foot cube of the web is destroyed if it takes at least 10 acid, fire, or slashing damage on a single turn.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If Keresta isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.While in bat form, Keresta can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.While in mist form, Keresta can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all non-magical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Keresta fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description: Reaction: When it drops to 0 HP outside its resting place, Keresta transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.While it has 0 HP in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 HP, it regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Keresta regains 20 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Keresta takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Keresta's next turn.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Keresta is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (15), +7 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Guidance (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Touch) Touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.
  • Mending (Cantrip, 1 Min., Instantaneous, Transmutation, Touch) Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.
  • Resistance (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder. When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
5st level:
  • Antilife Shell (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier.If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.
  • Destructive Wave (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Self) Destructive energy ripples outward from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in the Emanation makes a Constitution Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, a target takes 5d6 Thunder damage and 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) and has the Prone condition. On a successful Reaction Roll, a target takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Keresta can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries.description: Reaction: Keresta has the following flaws:Forbiddance. Keresta can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.Harmed by Running Water. Keresta takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Keresta's heart while Keresta is incapacitated in its resting place, Keresta is paralyzed until the stake is removed.Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Keresta takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks.

entries.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Keresta magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Keresta can call 3d6 giant centipedes instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Keresta and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Keresta dies, or until Keresta dismisses them as a bonus action.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to keresta moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to keresta makes one unarmed strike.

entries.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to keresta makes one bite attack.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries.description: Passive: Kettlesteam can mimic any sounds she has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful Difficulty (13) Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Kettlesteam casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)) At will:
  • Disguise Self (1st, Action, 1 hour, Illusion, Self) Make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—look different until the spell ends. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.
  • Friends (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 10 feet) Magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
1/day:
  • Bestow Curse (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Necromancy, Touch) Touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or become cursed for the duration. Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice:Choose one ability. The target has penalty on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability.The target has penalty on attack rolls against you.In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Speak with Animals (1st, Action, 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.

entries.name: Twilight Sleep (2/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Kettlesteam targets one creature she can see within 10 feet of her. The target is engulfed in a cloud of magical, sleep-inducing gas and must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Constitution Reaction Roll or fall unconscious for 1 minute. A creature put to sleep by this gas awakens instantly if it takes damage, or if someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

entries.name: Psychic Leech
entries.description: Reaction: At the start of each of Kevetta's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Difficulty (15) Wisdom Reaction Roll or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

entries.name: Thrives on Company
entries.description: Passive: Kevetta has a bonus on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has penalty on attack rolls.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Sorrowful Embrace
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to each creature grappled by kevetta must make a difficulty (15) wisdom reaction roll, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed reaction roll, or half as much damage on a successful one. in either case, kevetta pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries.description: Passive: Magical darkness doesn't impede Khai's darkvision.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Khai has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (fire).

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to each creature of khai's choice that is within 120 feet and aware of khai must succeed on a difficulty (18) wisdom reaction roll or become frightened of it for 1 minute. a creature can repeat the reaction roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. if a creature's reaction roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to khai's frightful presence for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Incite Fanaticism
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to khai chooses up to four other creatures within 60 feet of it that can see it. until the start of khai's next turn, each of those creatures makes attack rolls with a bonus and can't be frightened.

entries.name: Power of the Dragon Queen
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to khai targets one dragon it can see within 120 feet of it. the dragon must make a difficulty (18) charisma reaction roll. a chromatic dragon makes this reaction roll with penalty. on a successful reaction roll, the target is immune to khai's power of the dragon queen for 1 hour. on a failed reaction roll, the target is charmed by khai for 1 hour. while charmed in this way, the target regards khai as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. this effect ends if khai or its companions deal damage to the target.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Action: Khalessa owns a hat of disguise, which she uses to appear as a female drow while in the company of drow.

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.description: Passive: On each of its turns, Khalessa can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Khalessa has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Khalessa to sleep.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Passive: Khalessa can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.

entries.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries.description: Reaction: Khalessa deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has a bonus on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Khalessa that isn't incapacitated and Khalessa doesn't have penalty on the attack roll.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: Passive: Kharbek has a bonus on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Exhaustion
entries.description: Passive: Kharbek has 5 levels of exhaustion.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries.description: Passive: Kharbek has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

name: Khaspere Drylund

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to this adversary, defeat an additional Minion within range that the attack would hit.

entries.name: Rapier
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d8+1 damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Steal, Flee when outnumbered, Attack in groups

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If the ki-rin fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The ki-rin has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The ki-rin casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17)) At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Major Image (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Illusion, 120 feet) Create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause conditions.If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, for things can pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
3/day:
  • Cure Wounds (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Creature you touch regains a number of HP equal to 2d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Lesser Restoration (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
  • Sending (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Divination, Unlimited) Send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. The spell enables targets to understand the meaning of your message.You can send the message across any distance and even to other planes of existence, but if the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message doesn't arrive. You know if the delivery fails.Upon receiving your message, a creature can block your ability to reach it again with this spell for 8 hours. If you try to send another message during that time, you learn that you are blocked, and the spell fails.
1/day:
  • Banishment (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, 30 feet) One creature that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the Incapacitated condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.If the target is an Aberration, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend, the target doesn't return if the spell lasts for 1 minute. The target is instead transported to a random location on a plane (DM's choice) associated with its creature type.
  • Calm Emotions (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature):The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.
  • Create Food and Water (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 30 feet) Create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water on the ground or in containers within range—both useful in fending off the hazards of malnutrition and dehydration. The food is bland but nourishing and looks like a food of your choice, and the water is clean. The food spoils after 24 hours if uneaten.
  • Greater Restoration (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:1 Exhaustion levelThe Charmed or Petrified conditionA curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic itemAny reduction to one of the target's ability scoresAny reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
  • Plane Shift (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Touch) And up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the DM.Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.
  • Protection from Evil and Good (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Abjuration, Touch) Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against creatures that are Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead. The protection grants several benefits. Creatures of those types have penalty on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened conditions from them. If the target is already possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such a creature, the target has a bonus on any new Reaction Roll against the relevant effect.
  • Revivify (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, Touch) Touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can't revive a creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.
  • Wind Walk (6th, 1 Min., 8 hours, Transmutation, 30 feet) And up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a target has a Fly Speed of 300 feet and can hover; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. The only actions a target can take in this form are the Dash action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.If a target is in cloud form and flying when the effect ends, the target descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can't land after 1 minute, it falls the remaining distance.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the ki-rin moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Smite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the ki-rin makes one hoof, horn, or sacred fire attack.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The kiddywidget doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened

entries.name: Hold Breath
entries.description: Passive: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 5d6+4 damage.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The kindori doesn't require food, drink, or air.

entries.name: Tail

entries.name: Flashing Eyes (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Presence Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage and have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: Hekaton can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The giant's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17)). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Feather Fall (1st, Reaction, 1 minute, Transmutation, 60 feet) Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
3/day:
  • Control Weather (8th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 8 hours, Transmutation, Self) Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.PrecipitationStageCondition1Clear2Light clouds3Overcast or ground fog4Rain, hail, or snow5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzardTemperatureStageCondition1Heat wave2Hot3Warm4Cool5Cold6FreezingWindStageCondition1Calm2Moderate wind3Strong wind4Gale5Storm
  • Water Breathing (3rd, Action, 24 hours, Transmutation (ritual), 30 feet) Grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Hekaton hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point he can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a Difficulty (17) Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed Reaction Roll, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Thunderous Stomp (Recharge 6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to create a shock wave in a Far range area. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (17). Targets who fail take 6d10 lightning damage and have the Deafened condition until the end of their next turn. Targets who succeed take half damage only.

entries.name: Ashen Creature
entries.description: Reaction: When Jhaeros drops to 0 HP, he explodes in a harmless cloud of ashes, leaving nothing else behind.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.description: Passive: Whenever Jhaeros starts its turn with 60 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, Jhaeros goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, Jhaeros attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, Jhaeros attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once Jhaeros goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP.

entries.name: Fire Absorption
entries.description: Passive: Whenever Jhaeros is subjected to fire damage, he takes no damage and instead regains a number of HP equal to the fire damage dealt.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: Passive: Jhaeros is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Jhaeros has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries.description: Passive: Jhaeros's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Detect Invisibility
entries.description: Passive: The King of Feathers can see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible.

entries.description:
Passive: The King of Feathers's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spell, requiring no material components At will:
  • Misty Step (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If the King of Feathers fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range area. All targets within that area must make a Reaction Roll against this adversary's Difficulty. Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage.
