entries.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to the spell, as indicated:1/day each: arms of Hadar (1 brain), detect magic (2 brains), magic missile (3 brains), Tenser's floating disk (4 brains), darkness (5 brains), hold person (6 brains), invisibility (7 brains), spider climb (8 brains), fear (9 brains), hypnotic pattern (10 brains), major image (11 brains), stinking cloud (12 brains). The neh-thalggu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (11)). It must have consumed the requisite number of brains to cast the spell, as indicated 1/day:
  • Arms of Hadar (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Invoking Hadar, you cause tendrils to erupt from yourself. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you makes a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, a target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, a target takes half as much damage only.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Magic Missile (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
  • Tenser's Floating Disk (1st, Action, 1 hour, Conjuration (ritual), 30 feet) Creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The disk remains for the duration and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.The disk is immobile while you are within 20 feet of it. If you move more than 20 feet away from it, the disk follows you so that it remains within 20 feet of you. It can move across uneven terrain, up or down stairs, slopes and the like, but it can't cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more. For example, the disk can't move across a 10-foot-deep pit, nor could it leave such a pit if it was created at the bottom.If you move more than 100 feet from the disk (typically because it can't move around an obstacle to follow you), the spell ends.
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Hold Person (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Spider Climb (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Touch) Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
  • Fear (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, Self) Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.A Frightened creature takes the Dash action and moves away from you by the safest route on each of its turns unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends on that creature.
  • Hypnotic Pattern (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0.The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
  • Major Image (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Illusion, 120 feet) Create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted, but it can't deal damage or cause conditions.If you are within range of the illusion, you can take a Magic action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example.Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, for things can pass through it. A creature that takes a Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.
  • Stinking Cloud (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Conjuration, 90 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud is Heavily Obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution Reaction Roll or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn. While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take an action or a Bonus Action.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries.description: Passive: Magical darkness doesn't impede the neogi's darkvision.

entries.name: Mental Fortitude
entries.description: Passive: The neogi has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed or frightened, and magic can't put the neogi to sleep.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The neogi casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability 1/day:
  • Dimension Door (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 500 feet) Teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

entries.name: Enslave (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The neogi targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a Difficulty (14) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be magically charmed by the neogi for 1 day, or until the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The charmed target obeys the neogi's commands and can't take reactions, and the neogi and the target can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 1 mile. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Creature Sense
entries.description: Passive: The neothelid is aware of the presence of creatures within 1 mile of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each creature's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The neothelid has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The neothelid casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16)) At will:
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
1/day:
  • Confusion (4th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 90 feet) Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll, or that target can't take Bonus Actions or Reactions and must roll 1d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn, consulting the table below.1d10Behavior for the Turn1The target doesn't take an action, and it uses all its movement to move. Roll 1d4 for the direction: 1, north; 2, east; 3, south; or 4, west.2-6The target doesn't move or take actions.7-8The target doesn't move, and it takes the Attack action to make one melee attack against a random creature within reach. If none are within reach, the target takes no action.9-10The target chooses its behavior.At the end of each of its turns, an affected target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • feeblemind
  • Telekinesis (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) Gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell. Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the Reaction Roll. Object. You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

entries.name: Tentacles
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 3d8+8 acid damage and becomes *Restrained*.

entries.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale acid in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 10d6 acid damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Illumination
entries.description: Passive: Nepartak sheds either dim light in a 15-foot radius, or bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. It can switch between the options as an action.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Nepartak has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries.description: Passive: If Nepartak is destroyed, it regains all its HP in 1 hour unless holy water is sprinkled on its remains or a dispel magic or remove curse spell is cast on them.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Nepartak is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It requires no somatic or material components to cast its spells. Nepartak has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
3st level:
  • Fireball (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 150 feet) Bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (fire).

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The nereid can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Aquatic Invisibility
entries.description: Action: If immersed in water, the nereid can make itself invisible as a bonus action. It remains invisible until it leaves the water, ends the invisibility as a bonus action, or dies.

entries.name: Mantle Dependent
entries.description: Passive: The nereid wears a mantle of silky cloth the color of sea foam, which holds the creature's spirit. The mantle has an AC and HP equal to that of the nereid, but the garment can't be directly harmed while the nereid wears it. If the mantle is destroyed, the nereid becomes poisoned and dies within 1 hour. A nereid is willing to do anything in its power to recover the mantle if it is stolen, including serving the thief.

entries.name: Shape Water
entries.description: Passive: The nereid can cast control water at will, requiring no components. Its spellcasting ability for it is Charisma. This use of the spell has a range of 30 feet and can affect a cube of water no larger than 30 feet on a side.

entries.name: Speak With Animals
entries.description: Passive: The nereid can comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts.

entries.name: Blinding Acid
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 2d12+3 acid damage.

entries.name: Drowning Kiss (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to use this ability in a Far range area. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take 3d12+3 acid damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Water Lash
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range line. All targets within that area must make Strength Reaction Roll (13). Targets who fail take 4d6+3 damage and have the Prone condition until the end of their next turn. Targets who succeed take half damage only.

name: Nergaliid

entries.name: Shadow Stealth
entries.description: Passive: While in dim light or darkness, the nergaliid can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

entries.name: Standing Leap
entries.description: Passive: The nergaliid's long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 2d8+4 poison damage and becomes *Poisoned*.

entries.name: Tongue Lash
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d12+4 damage.

entries.name: Siphon Life (Recharge 4–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The nergaliid magically draws the life from a humanoid it can see within 40 feet of it. The target must make a Difficulty (15) Wisdom Reaction Roll. An incapacitated target fails the Reaction Roll automatically. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the nergaliid gains temporary HP equal to the damage taken. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage, and the nergaliid doesn't gain temporary HP. If this damage kills the target, its body rises at the end of the nergaliid's current turn as a husk zombie (see earlier in this chapter).

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Aid allies, Disrupt enemies, Corrupt, Destroy

entries.name: Draconic Majesty
entries.description: Passive: Neronvain adds his Charisma bonus to his AC (included).

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Magic can't put Neronvain to sleep.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Poisonous Cloud (2/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range emanation. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage (poison).

name: Nerozar the Defeated

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: Reaction: If damage reduces Nerozar to 0 HP, it must make a Constitution Reaction Roll with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, Nerozar drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 4d6 damage.

entries.name: Eye Ray
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Nerozar uses a random magical eye ray, choosing a target that it can see within 60 feet of it.1. Paralyzing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a Difficulty (14) Constitution Reaction Roll or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.2. Fear Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a Difficulty (14) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.3. Enervation Ray. The targeted creature must make a Difficulty (14) Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on a failed Reaction Roll, or half as much damage on a successful one.4. Telekinetic Ray. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Difficulty (14) Strength Reaction Roll, or Nerozar moves it up to 30 feet in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of Nerozar's next turn or until Nerozar is incapacitated. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to 30 feet in any direction. Nerozar can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or container.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened, Destroy life

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Nester has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Nester is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks). Nester can cast disguise self and invisibility At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
  • Shocking Grasp (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Touch) Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
  • Shocking Grasp (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Touch) Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
9st level:
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+2 damage.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Passive: Nezznar has a fully charged spider staff (see appendix B).

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Nezznar has a bonus on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself, and magic can't put him to sleep.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: Nezznar has penalty on attack rolls while he or his target is in sunlight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Nezznar casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13) unless otherwise noted) At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Spider Climb (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Touch) Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
  • Web (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Conjuration, 60 feet) Conjure a mass of sticky webbing at a point within range. The webs fill a 20-foot Cube there for the duration. The webs are Difficult Terrain, and the area within them is Lightly Obscured.If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. Webs layered over a flat surface have a depth of 5 feet.The first time a creature enters the webs on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or have the Restrained condition while in the webs or until it breaks free.A creature Restrained by the webs can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If it succeeds, it is no longer Restrained.The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot Cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 Fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.
1/day:
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Invisibility (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Illusion, Touch) Creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends. The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
  • Mage Armor (1st, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
  • Magic Missile (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.
  • Suggestion (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 8 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to one creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. The suggestion must sound achievable and not involve anything that would obviously deal damage to the target or its allies. For example, you could say, "Fetch the key to the cult's treasure vault, and give the key to me." Or you could say, "Stop fighting, leave this library peacefully, and don't return."The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration or until you or your allies deal damage to the target. The Charmed target pursues the suggestion to the best of its ability. The suggested activity can continue for the entire duration, but if the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends for the target upon completing it.

entries.name: Aura of Murder
entries.description: Passive: As long as the night blade is not incapacitated, hostile creatures within 5 feet of it gain vulnerability to piercing damage unless they have resistance or immunity to such damage.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+2 damage.

entries.name: Coven Magic
entries.description: Reaction: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14)): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The hag has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Soul Bag
entries.description: Passive: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action.The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 HP. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day; Requires Soul Bag)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell.If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14)) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Etherealness (7th, Action, 8 hours, Conjuration, Self) Step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can perceive the plane you left, which looks gray, and you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away.While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by creatures, objects, and effects on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive or interact with you unless a feature gives them the ability to do so.When the spell ends, you return to the plane you left in the spot that corresponds to your space in the Border Ethereal. If you appear in an occupied space, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.This spell ends instantly if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn't border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.
  • Magic Missile (1st, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart strikes a creature of your choice that you can see within range. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
  • Ray of Frost (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
  • Shocking Grasp (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Touch) Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
9st level:
  • Prismatic Wall (9th, Action, 10 minutes, Abjuration, 60 feet) Shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point within range. Alternatively, you shape the wall into a globe up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point within range. The wall lasts for the duration. If you position the wall in a space occupied by a creature, the spell ends instantly without effect.The wall sheds Bright Light within 100 feet and Dim Light for an additional 100 feet. You and creatures you designate when you cast the spell can pass through and be near the wall without harm. If another creature that can see the wall moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Constitution Reaction Roll or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute.The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature reaches into or passes through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the layers. Each layer forces the creature to make a Dexterity Reaction Roll or be affected by that layer's properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table.The wall, which has AC 10, can be destroyed one layer at a time, in order from red to violet, by means specific to each layer. If a layer is destroyed, it is gone for the duration. Antimagic Field has no effect on the wall, and Dispel Magic can affect only the violet layer.Prismatic LayersOrderEffects1Red. Failed Reaction Roll: 12d6 Fire damage. Successful Reaction Roll: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: non-magical ranged attacks can't pass through this layer, which is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Cold damage.2Orange. Failed Reaction Roll: 12d6 Acid damage. Successful Reaction Roll: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Magical ranged attacks can't pass through this layer, which is destroyed by a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind).3Yellow. Failed Reaction Roll: 12d6 Lightning damage. Successful Reaction Roll: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 60 Force damage.4Green. Failed Reaction Roll: 12d6 Poison damage. Successful Reaction Roll: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: A Passwall spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer.5Blue. Failed Reaction Roll: 12d6 Cold damage. Successful Reaction Roll: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Fire damage.6Indigo. Failed Reaction Roll: The target has the Restrained condition and makes a Constitution Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the Petrified condition until it is freed by an effect like the Greater Restoration spell. The successes and failures needn't be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. Additional Effects: Spells can't be cast through this layer, which is destroyed by Bright Light shed by the Daylight spell.7Violet. Failed Reaction Roll: The target has the Blinded condition and makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll at the start of your next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the condition ends. On a failed Reaction Roll, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM's choice). Additional Effects: This layer is destroyed by Dispel Magic.

Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The noble casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16)) At will:
  • Mage Armor (1st, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
1/day:
  • Befuddlement (8th, Action, Instantaneous, Enchantment, 150 feet) Blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence Reaction Roll.On a failed Reaction Roll, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell.On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage only.
  • Detect Thoughts (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Self) Activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC, ending the spell on a success.
  • Fly (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
  • Scrying (5th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, Self) Can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the Reaction Roll against, only that it feels uneasy.Your Knowledge of the Target Is...Reaction Roll ModifierSecondhand (heard of the target)+5Firsthand (met the target)+0Extensive (know the target well)-5You Have the Target's...Reaction Roll ModifierPicture or other likeness-2Garment or other possession-4Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail-10On a successful Reaction Roll, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.
  • Shatter (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Loud noise erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered there makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 3d8 Thunder damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A Construct has penalty on the Reaction Roll.A non-magical object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the spell's area.

  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself.   • Feather Fall (1st, Reaction, 1 minute, Transmutation, 60 feet) Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
3/day:
  • Control Weather (8th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 8 hours, Transmutation, Self) Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.PrecipitationStageCondition1Clear2Light clouds3Overcast or ground fog4Rain, hail, or snow5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzardTemperatureStageCondition1Heat wave2Hot3Warm4Cool5Cold6FreezingWindStageCondition1Calm2Moderate wind3Strong wind4Gale5Storm
  • Water Breathing (3rd, Action, 24 hours, Transmutation (ritual), 30 feet) Grants up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear heavier or lighter. You must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs as you have. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing.To discern that you are disguised, a creature must take the Study action to inspect your appearance and succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Ogrémoch's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (20), +12 to hit with spell attacks). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Meld into Stone (3rd, Action, 8 hours, Transmutation (ritual), Touch) Step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, merging yourself and your equipment with the stone for the duration. You must touch the stone to do so. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by non-magical senses.While merged with the stone, you can't see what occurs outside it, and any Wisdom (Perception) checks you make to hear sounds outside it are made with penalty. You remain aware of the passage of time and can cast spells on yourself while merged in the stone. You can use 5 feet of movement to leave the stone where you entered it, which ends the spell. You otherwise can't move.Minor physical damage to the stone doesn't harm you, but its partial destruction or a change in its shape (to the extent that you no longer fit within it) expels you and deals 6d6 Force damage to you. The stone's complete destruction (or transmutation into a different substance) expels you and deals 50 Force damage to you. If expelled, you move into an unoccupied space closest to where you first entered and have the Prone condition.
  • Move Earth (6th, Action, Concentration, up to 2 hours, Transmutation, 120 feet) Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area's elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar. The extent of any such changes can't exceed half the area's largest dimension. For example, if you affect a 40-foot square, you can create a pillar up to 20 feet high, raise or lower the square's elevation by up to 20 feet, dig a trench up to 20 feet deep, and so on. It takes 10 minutes for these changes to complete. Because the terrain's transformation occurs slowly, creatures in the area can't usually be trapped or injured by the ground's movement.At the end of every 10 minutes you spend Concentrating on the spell, you can choose a new area of terrain to affect within range.This spell can't manipulate natural stone or stone construction. Rocks and structures shift to accommodate the new terrain. If the way you shape the terrain would make a structure unstable, it might collapse.Similarly, this spell doesn't directly affect plant growth. The moved earth carries any plants along with it.
  • Wall of Stone (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 120 feet) non-magical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick.If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity Reaction Roll. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can't occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn't need to be vertical or rest on a firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone. Thus, you can use this spell to bridge a chasm or create a ramp.If you create a span greater than 20 feet in length, you must halve the size of each panel to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create battlements and the like.The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch of thickness, and it has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Reducing a panel to 0 HP destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM's discretion.If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for its full duration, the wall becomes permanent and can't be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.

Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Hold Monster (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 90 feet) Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Spirit Guardians (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, Self) Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation, and whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, the creature must make a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 Necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Divine Strike
entries.description: Reaction: Once on each of his turns when he hits a creature with a weapon attack, Omin can cause the attack to deal an extra 4 (1d8) damage of the same type dealt by the weapon.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Omin has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Omin is a 9th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (15), +7 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Guidance (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Touch) Touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Spare the Dying (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 15 feet) Choose a creature within range that has 0 HP and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
5st level:
  • Dispel Evil and Good (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Self) For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have penalty on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the Charmed or Frightened condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures. Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be sent back to its home plane if it isn't there already. If they aren't on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.
  • Flame Strike (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.
  • Hold Monster (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 90 feet) Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Greater Restoration (5th, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, Touch) Touch a creature and magically remove one of the following effects from it:1 Exhaustion levelThe Charmed or Petrified conditionA curse, including the target's Attunement to a cursed magic itemAny reduction to one of the target's ability scoresAny reduction to the target's Hit Point maximum
  • Legend Lore (5th, 10 Min., Instantaneous, Divination, Self) Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the DM.The lore might consist of important details, amusing revelations, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. The more information you already know about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is. That information is accurate but might be couched in figurative language or poetry, as determined by the DM.If the famous thing you chose isn't actually famous, you hear sad musical notes played on a trombone, and the spell fails.

entries.name: Chilling Mist
entries.description: Passive: While it is alive, the one-eyed shiver projects an aura of cold mist within 10 feet of itself. If the one-eyed shiver deals damage to a creature in this area, the creature also takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The one-eyed shiver is a 5th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It knows the following sorcerer spells At will:
  • Chill Touch (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, Touch) Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain HP until the end of your next turn.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
3st level:

If the creature ends its turn in a space where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends on that creature.

entries.name: Shape-Shift
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the oni shape-shifts into a small or medium humanoid or a large giant, or it returns to its true form. other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)) 1/day:
  • Charm Person (1st, Action, 1 hour, Enchantment, 30 feet) One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. It does so with a bonus if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The Charmed creature is Friendly to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Gaseous Form (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Touch) Willing creature you touch shape-shifts, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 HP or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself.While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.The target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. Finally, the target can't attack or cast spells.

If the target fails the second Reaction Roll, the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell's effect.Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.

entries.name: Dealing with Onyx
entries.description: Passive: Onyx cannot be overcome or killed by combat. Any weapon attack against her that hits AC 12 makes contact but deals no lasting damage. However, if the attack would deal 10 or more damage, Onyx has penalty on attack rolls until the end of her next turn. If Onyx would take 10 or more damage from spells or other effects, it yields the same result. Spells that impose conditions function normally against Onyx, but those conditions end automatically at the end of the cat's next turn.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries.description: Passive: The cat has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Relative Size
entries.description: Passive: Any damage Onyx would take is reduced to 0. She has a bonus on ability checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Minion (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to this adversary, defeat an additional Minion within range that the attack would hit.

entries.name: Claws
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 2d10 damage.

entries.name: Corrosive Form
entries.description: Passive: A creature that touches the Ooze Master or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) acid damage. Any non-magical weapon that hits the Ooze Master corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. non-magical ammunition that hits the Ooze Master is destroyed after dealing damage.The Ooze Master can eat through 2-inch-thick, non-magical wood or metal in 1 round.

entries.name: Instinctive Attack
entries.description: Reaction: When the Ooze Master casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action, it can make one pseudopod attack as a bonus action.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The Ooze Master is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (15), +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Acid Splash (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Create an acidic bubble at a point within range, where it explodes in a 5-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d6 Acid damage.
  • Friends (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 10 feet) Magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration.   • Poison Spray (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 30 feet) Spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.
5st level:
  • Cloudkill (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, 120 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. Its area is Heavily Obscured.Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this Reaction Roll when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

entries.description: Passive: The Ooze Master can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

If the target is prone, Ophelia can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

entries.name: Gore
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 3d8+6 damage.

entries.name: Stomp
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 3d10+6 damage.

entries.name: Blessings of the Gods
entries.description: Action: While the oracle is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier. In addition, a creature that hits the oracle with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 9 (2d8) force damage.

Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.

You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
3/day:
  • Bless (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 30 feet) Bless up to three creatures within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a Reaction Roll before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to the attack roll or Reaction Roll.
  • Guiding Bolt (1st, Action, 1 round, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has a bonus.

The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
1/day:

The DM chooses the omen from the Omens table.OmensOmenFor Results That Will Be...WealGoodWoeBadWeal and woeGood and badIndifferenceNeither good nor badThe spell doesn't account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results.If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

The target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the Reaction Roll against, only that it feels uneasy.Your Knowledge of the Target Is...Reaction Roll ModifierSecondhand (heard of the target)+5Firsthand (met the target)+0Extensive (know the target well)-5You Have the Target's...Reaction Roll ModifierPicture or other likeness-2Garment or other possession-4Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail-10On a successful Reaction Roll, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to use this ability in a Far range line. All targets within that area must make Strength Reaction Roll (18). Targets who fail take 6d10 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
