entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Aid allies, Disrupt enemies, Destroy life, Spread corruption
original_cr: None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)

entries.name: False Appearance
entries.description: Passive: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

entries.name: Siege Monster
entries.description: Passive: The tree deals double damage to objects and structures.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The tree magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as a treant, except they have Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, they can't speak, and they have only the Slam action option. An animated tree acts as an ally of the tree. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until the tree dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree; or until the tree takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The medusa's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14)). The medusa can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components 1/day:
  • Expeditious Retreat (1st, Bonus, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Self) Take the Dash action, and until the spell ends, you can take that action again as a Bonus Action.
  • Fog Cloud (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Conjuration, 120 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.
  • Misty Step (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The medusa has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Surprise Attack
entries.description: Passive: During the first round of combat, the medusa has a bonus on attack rolls against any creature that is surprised, and it deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage each time it hits such a creature with an attack.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The medusa fixes its gaze on one creature within 60 feet of it that it can see and that can see its eyes. The target must make a Difficulty (14) Constitution Reaction Roll. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the Reaction Roll begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by a greater restoration spell or similar magic.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries.description: Passive: As a bonus action, the cerberus can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature that it can see.

entries.name: Multiheaded
entries.description: Passive: The cerberus can't be surprised, and it has a bonus on saving throws against being knocked unconscious.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: Passive: The cerberus has a bonus on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the cerberus's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (fire).

entries.name: Breath Weapon (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take 6d6 fire damage and have the Restrained condition until the end of their next turn. Targets who succeed take half damage only.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Aura of Radiance
entries.description: Passive: The councilor magically sheds bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 15 feet. The councilor can extinguish or restore this light as a bonus action. If the bright light overlaps with an area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created that darkness is dispelled.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The councilor has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: The councilor is a 13th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Guidance (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Touch) Touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.
  • Mending (Cantrip, 1 Min., Instantaneous, Transmutation, Touch) Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Spare the Dying (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 15 feet) Choose a creature within range that has 0 HP and isn't dead. The creature becomes Stable.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
7st level:
  • Plane Shift (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Touch) And up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the DM.Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The councilor touches another creature. The target magically regains 18 (3d8 + 5) HP and is freed from one curse afflicting it (councilor's choice).

entries.name: Flame Strike (5th-Level Spell; Requires a Spell Slot)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a Far range emanation. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (17). Targets who fail take 4d6 fire damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Touch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the councilor makes one attack with its radiant touch.

entries.name: Shimmering Aura (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the councilor channels positive energy into its aura of radiance. until the end of the councilor's next turn, it sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. any creature that starts its turn in the bright light must succeed on a difficulty (17) constitution reaction roll or be blinded until the end of the councilor's next turn.

entries.name: Illumination
entries.description: Passive: The soldier magically sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The soldier can extinguish or restore this light as a bonus action.

entries.name: Turn Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The soldier has a bonus on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (radiant).

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If the unicorn fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The unicorn has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14)) At will:
  • Detect Evil and Good (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, Self) For the duration, you sense the location of any Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead within 30 feet of yourself. You also sense whether the Hallow spell is active there and, if so, where.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Druidcraft (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.
1/day:
  • Calm Emotions (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) Each Humanoid in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be affected by one of the following effects (choose for each creature):The creature has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the spell ends. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.The creature becomes Indifferent about creatures of your choice that it's Hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target takes damage or witnesses its allies taking damage. When the spell ends, the creature's attitude returns to normal.
  • Dispel Evil and Good (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Abjuration, Self) For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have penalty on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions. Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the Charmed or Frightened condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures. Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll or be sent back to its home plane if it isn't there already. If they aren't on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.
  • Entangle (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Conjuration, 90 feet) Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain. They disappear when the spell ends.Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.
  • Pass without Trace (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Abjuration, Self) Radiate a concealing aura in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
  • Word of Recall (6th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 5 feet) And up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect.You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there.

entries.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts Cure Wounds or Lesser Restoration on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

entries.name: Charging Horn
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Shimmering Shield
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. the target gains 10 (3d6) temporary hp, and its ac increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. the unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Formed by the Mists
entries.description: Reaction: When created, the horror's body composition takes one of four forms: Aberrant Armor, Loathsome Limbs, Malleable Mass, or Oozing Organs. This form determines certain traits in this stat block.

entries.name: Amorphous (Malleable Mass Only)
entries.description: Passive: The horror can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Bile Body (Oozing Organs Only)
entries.description: Passive: Any creature that touches the horror or hits it with a melee attack takes 5 (1d10) acid damage.

entries.name: Relentless Stride (Loathsome Limbs Only)
entries.description: Reaction: The horror can move through the space of another creature. The first time on a turn that the horror enters a creature's space during this move, the creature must succeed on a Difficulty (16) Strength Reaction Roll or be knocked prone.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Hex Blast (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to use this ability in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take 7d12 necrotic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Giant Slayer
entries.description: Passive: Any weapon attack that Urgala makes against a giant deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage on a hit.

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: Passive: A retired adventurer, Urgala owns a respectable inn, the North shield House, and she doesn't want to see it or her neighbors' homes destroyed. She has no tolerance for monsters or bullies.Ideal: "We live in a violent world, and sometimes violence is necessary for survival."Bond: "My home is my life. Threaten it, and I'll hurt you."Flaw: "I know how treacherous and greedy adventurers can be. I don't trust them—any of them."

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Assassinate
entries.description: Passive: During its first turn, Urstul has a bonus on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Urstul scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

entries.name: Evasion
entries.description: Reaction: If Urstul is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity Reaction Roll to take only half damage, Urstul instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the Reaction Roll, and only half damage if it fails.

entries.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries.description: Reaction: Urstul deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has a bonus on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Urstul that isn't incapacitated and Urstul doesn't have penalty on the attack roll.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: Urwin can use its action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid or into a raven, or back into its human form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its human form if it dies.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries.description: Passive: Urwin can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Difficulty (10) Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Urwin regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If Urwin takes damage from a silvered weapon or a spell, this trait doesn't function at the start of Urwin's next turn. Urwin dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Multiattack (Human or Hybrid Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Reckless
entries.description: Passive: At the start of its turn, the barbarian can gain bonus on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Greataxe
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d12+3 damage.

entries.name: Oathbow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d8+3 damage.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+2 damage.

entries.name: Shortbow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+1 damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting (Requires a Sacred Bundle)
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to as 1 action), bestow curse, cordon of arrows, detect magic, speak with dead, spirit guardians. The shaman casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12); +4 to hit with spell attacks) At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
1/day:
  • Augury (2nd, 1 Min., Instantaneous, Divination (ritual), Self) Receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses the omen from the Omens table.OmensOmenFor Results That Will Be...WealGoodWoeBadWeal and woeGood and badIndifferenceNeither good nor badThe spell doesn't account for circumstances, such as other spells, that might change the results.If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.
  • Bestow Curse (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Necromancy, Touch) Touch a creature, which must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or become cursed for the duration. Until the curse ends, the target suffers one of the following effects of your choice:Choose one ability. The target has penalty on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability.The target has penalty on attack rolls against you.In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.
  • Cordon of Arrows (2nd, Action, 8 hours, Transmutation, Touch) Touch up to four non-magical Arrows or Bolts and plant them in the ground in your space. Until the spell ends, the ammunition can't be physically uprooted, and whenever a creature other than you enters a space within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to strike it. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 2d4 Piercing damage. The piece of ammunition is then destroyed. The spell ends when none of the ammunition remains planted in the ground.When you cast this spell, you can designate any creatures you choose, and the spell ignores them.
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Speak with Dead (3rd, Action, 10 minutes, Necromancy, 10 feet) Grant the semblance of life to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer questions you pose. The corpse must have a mouth, and this spell fails if the deceased creature was Undead when it died. The spell also fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the past 10 days.Until the spell ends, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are antagonistic toward it or it recognizes you as an enemy. This spell doesn't return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Thus, the corpse can't learn new information, doesn't comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can't speculate about future events.
  • Spirit Guardians (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, Self) Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation, and whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, the creature must make a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 Necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.

entries.name: Limited Magic Immunity
entries.description: Passive: Uvashar can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has a bonus on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (magic).

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: Passive: Uzoma has a bonus on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Spear
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6+1 damage.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Vaal's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Fog Cloud (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Conjuration, 120 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
3/day:
  • Feather Fall (1st, Reaction, 1 minute, Transmutation, 60 feet) Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
  • Fly (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
  • Misty Step (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
  • Telekinesis (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) Gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell. Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the Reaction Roll. Object. You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.
1/day:
  • Control Weather (8th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 8 hours, Transmutation, Self) Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.PrecipitationStageCondition1Clear2Light clouds3Overcast or ground fog4Rain, hail, or snow5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzardTemperatureStageCondition1Heat wave2Hot3Warm4Cool5Cold6FreezingWindStageCondition1Calm2Moderate wind3Strong wind4Gale5Storm
  • Gaseous Form (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 hour, Transmutation, Touch) Willing creature you touch shape-shifts, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 HP or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself.While in this form, the target's only method of movement is a Fly Speed of 10 feet, and it can hover. The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature. The target has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. The target can pass through narrow openings, but it treats liquids as though they were solid surfaces.The target can't talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can't be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. Finally, the target can't attack or cast spells.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries.description: Passive: Vaal has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: Vaasha can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: Passive: Vaasha is a skilled hunter and tracker who doesn't charge into danger without first assessing the risks. She's not afraid to speak her mind, even to her king. To her, a worthy leader values the truth, no matter how painful it is.Ideal: "I want this conflict over with so that I can return to the quiet stillness of the ocean depths."Bond: "I'll protect this beautiful world from the ravages of evil with my dying breath."Flaw: "I don't care if my words hurt others' feelings."

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Lightning Strike (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Vaasha hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a Difficulty (17) Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 54 (12d8) lightning damage on a failed Reaction Roll, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a area of Medium range. All targets within that area must make a Reaction Roll against this adversary's Difficulty. Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage (magic).

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries.description: Passive: The heir has a bonus on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the heir's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The heir casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)) At will:
  • Druidcraft (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 30 feet) Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range. Weather Sensor. You create a Tiny, harmless sensory effect that predicts what the weather will be at your location for the next 24 hours. The effect might manifest as a golden orb for clear skies, a cloud for rain, falling snowflakes for snow, and so on. This effect persists for 1 round. Bloom. You instantly make a flower blossom, a seed pod open, or a leaf bud bloom. Sensory Effect. You create a harmless sensory effect, such as falling leaves, spectral dancing fairies, a gentle breeze, the sound of an animal, or the faint odor of skunk. The effect must fit in a 5-foot Cube. Fire Play. You light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a campfire.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Speak with Animals (1st, Action, 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts, and you can use any of the Influence action's skill options with them.Most Beasts have little to say about topics that don't pertain to survival or companionship, but at minimum, a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever it has perceived within the past day.
3/day:
  • Animal Friendship (1st, Action, 24 hours, Enchantment, 30 feet) Target a Beast that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. If you or one of your allies deals damage to the target, the spells ends.
  • Animal Messenger (2nd, Action, 24 hours, Enchantment (ritual), 30 feet) Tiny Beast of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Charisma Reaction Roll, or it attempts to deliver a message for you (if the target's Challenge Rating isn't 0, it automatically succeeds). You specify a location you have visited and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a person dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also communicate a message of up to twenty-five words. The Beast travels for the duration toward the specified location, covering about 25 miles per 24 hours or 50 miles if the Beast can fly.When the Beast arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, mimicking your communication. If the Beast doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the Beast returns to where you cast the spell.
1/day:
  • Ice Storm (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 300 feet) Hail falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll. A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Hailstones turn ground in the Cylinder into Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Spur Beast
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to the heir targets a beast it can see within 30 feet. the target can take a reaction to move up to half its speed and make one melee attack.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Vaeve has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Vaeve to sleep.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Vaeve's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12)). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
1/day:
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Vaeve is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14), +6 to hit with spell attacks). Vaeve has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
  • Poison Spray (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 30 feet) Spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.
  • Ray of Frost (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
5st level:
  • Cloudkill (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, 120 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this Reaction Roll when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, Vaeve has penalty on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 1d6 poison damage.

entries.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1 fiend, who appear at Far range.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Passive: Vajra wields the Blackstaff, accounted for in her statistics. Roll 2d10 to determine how many charges the staff has remaining.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Vajra has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Vajra is an 18th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (18), +12 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
9st level:
  • Imprisonment (9th, 1 Min., Until dispelled, Abjuration, 30 feet) Create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target is unaffected, and it is immune to this spell for the next 24 hours. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target is imprisoned. While imprisoned, the target doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the imprisoned target, and the target can't teleport.Until the spell ends, the target is also affected by one of the following effects of your choice:Burial. The target is entombed beneath the earth in a hollow globe of magical force that is just large enough to contain the target. Nothing can pass into or out of the globe.Chaining. Chains firmly rooted in the ground hold the target in place. The target has the Restrained condition and can't be moved by any means.Hedged Prison. The target is trapped in a demiplane that is warded against teleportation and planar travel. The demiplane is your choice of a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or the like.Minimus Containment. The target becomes 1 inch tall and is trapped inside an indestructible gemstone or a similar object. Light can pass through the gemstone (allowing the target to see out and other creatures to see in), but nothing else can pass through by any means.Slumber. The target has the Unconscious condition and can't be awoken. Ending the Spell. When you cast the spell, specify a trigger that will end it. The trigger can be as simple or as elaborate as you choose, but the DM must agree that it has a high likelihood of happening within the next decade. The trigger must be an observable action, such as someone making a particular offering at the temple of your god, saving your true love, or defeating a specific monster.A Dispel Magic spell can end the spell only if it is cast with a level 9 spell slot, targeting either the prison or the component used to create it.

entries.name: Staff Spells
entries.description: Reaction: While holding the Blackstaff, Vajra can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using her spell Reaction Roll DC and spell attack bonus: cone of cold (5 charges), fireball (5th-level version, 5 charges), globe of invulnerability (6 charges), hold monster (5 charges), levitate (2 charges), lightning bolt (5th-level version, 5 charges), magic missile (1 charge), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or wall of force (5 charges).

name: Valenar Hawk

The bond lasts until the hawk bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the hawk and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

entries.description: Passive: The hawk has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+4 damage.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened

entries.description: Action: The hound can magically bond with one creature it can see, immediately after spending at least 1 hour observing that creature while within 30 feet of it. The bond lasts until the hound bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the hound and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

entries.description: Passive: The hound has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 1d6+3 damage.

The bond lasts until the steed bonds with a different creature or until the bonded creature dies. While bonded, the steed and the bonded creature can communicate telepathically with each other at a distance of up to 100 feet.

entries.name: Hooves
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 2d6+3 damage.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: Valendar can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries.description: Passive: Valendar has a bonus on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Divine Eminence
entries.description: Passive: As a bonus action, Valetta can expend a spell slot to cause her melee weapon attacks to magically deal an extra 10 (3d6) radiant damage to a target on a hit. This benefit lasts until the end of the turn. If Valetta expends a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Valetta is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom. Valetta has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
3st level:
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Spirit Guardians (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, Self) Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation, and whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, the creature must make a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 Necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.

entries.name: Breathe Weapon
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a Far range line. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (11). Targets who fail take 2d6 lightning damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Mace
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Valin has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries.description: Passive: While her heart remains in Alessia's body, Valin re-forms inside her sarcophagus, regaining all her HP and becoming active again.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Valin Sarnaster is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks). Valin has the following cleric spells prepared At will:
  • Sacred Flame (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity Reaction Roll or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for this Reaction Roll.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
6st level:
  • Harm (6th, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 60 feet) Unleash virulent magic on a creature you can see within range. The target makes a Constitution Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, it takes 14d6 Necrotic damage, and its Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage it took. On a successful Reaction Roll, it takes half as much damage only. This spell can't reduce a target's Hit Point maximum below 1.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Dreadful Glare
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Valin targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Valin, it must succeed on a Difficulty (16) Wisdom Reaction Roll against this magic or become frightened until the end of Valin's next turn. If the target fails the Reaction Roll by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the Reaction Roll is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Attack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to valin makes one attack with her rotting fist or uses her dreadful glare.

entries.name: Blinding Dust
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around Valin. Each creature within 5 feet of Valin must succeed on a Difficulty (16) Constitution Reaction Roll or be blinded until the end of her next turn.

entries.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Valin utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of Valin that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a Difficulty (16) Constitution Reaction Roll or be stunned until the end of Valin's next turn.

entries.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Vanifer is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (16), +8 to hit with spell attacks). Vanifer knows the following sorcerer spells At will:
  • Chill Touch (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, Touch) Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can't regain HP until the end of your next turn.
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Friends (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 10 feet) Magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
  • Produce Flame (Cantrip, Bonus, 10 minutes, Conjuration, Self) Flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there for the duration. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again.Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.
  • Thaumaturgy (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Transmutation, 30 feet) Manifest a minor wonder within range. You create one of the effects below within range. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its 1-minute effects active at a time. Altered Eyes. You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute. Booming Voice. Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have bonus on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Fire Play. You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute. Invisible Hand. You instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut. Phantom Sound. You create an instantaneous sound that originates from a point of your choice within range, such as a rumble of thunder, the cry of a raven, or ominous whispers. Tremors. You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
5st level:
  • Dominate Person (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 60 feet) One Humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has a bonus on the Reaction Roll if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as "Attack that creature," "Move over there," or "Fetch that object." The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself.You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

Reaction: Varakkta's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13), +5 to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
3/day:
  • Jump (1st, Bonus, 1 minute, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. Once on each of its turns until the spell ends, that creature can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
  • Misty Step (2nd, Bonus, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Self) Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
  • Nondetection (3rd, Action, 8 hours, Abjuration, Touch) For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
  • Tongues (3rd, Action, 1 hour, Divination, Touch) Grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken or signed language that it hears or sees. Moreover, when the target communicates by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language can understand it if that creature can hear the speech or see the signing.
1/day:
  • Plane Shift (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, Touch) And up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. You can specify a target destination in general terms, such as the City of Brass on the Elemental Plane of Fire or the palace of Dispater on the second level of the Nine Hells, and you appear in or near that destination, as determined by the DM.Alternatively, if you know the sigil sequence of a teleportation circle on another plane of existence, this spell can take you to that circle. If the teleportation circle is too small to hold all the creatures you transported, they appear in the closest unoccupied spaces next to the circle.
  • Telekinesis (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) Gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell. Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the Reaction Roll. Object. You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.
