On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
9st level:
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 1d4+2 damage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Zikzokrishka fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to exhale thunder in a Far range line. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 12d10 lightning damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Zilchyn has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Zilchyn to sleep.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Zilchyn's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (12)). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
1/day:
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Zilchyn is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (14), +6 to hit with spell attacks). Zilchyn has the following wizard spells prepared At will:
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Minor Illusion (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Illusion, 30 feet) Create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.
  • Poison Spray (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Necromancy, 30 feet) Spray toxic mist at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d12 Poison damage.
  • Ray of Frost (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 60 feet) Frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
5st level:
  • Cloudkill (5th, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Conjuration, 120 feet) Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this Reaction Roll when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this Reaction Roll only once per turn.The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, Zilchyn has penalty on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Staff
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. On a success, the target takes 1d6 poison damage.

entries.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to summon 1 fiend, who appear at Far range.

entries.description: Passive: As a bonus action on his turn, Zindar can sprout a pair of dragon wings from his back, gaining a flying speed of 30 feet until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Zindar is a 14th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (15), +7 to hit with spell attacks). Zindar knows the following sorcerer spells At will:
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.
  • Friends (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Enchantment, 10 feet) Magically emanate a sense of friendship toward one creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Reaction Roll or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target succeeds automatically if it isn't a Humanoid, if you're fighting it, or if you have cast this spell on it within the past 24 hours.The spell ends early if the target takes damage or if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or force anyone to make a Reaction Roll. When the spell ends, the target knows it was Charmed by you.
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Mending (Cantrip, 1 Min., Instantaneous, Transmutation, Touch) Repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.This spell can physically repair a magic item, but it can't restore magic to such an object.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
7st level:
  • Fire Storm (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 150 feet) Storm of fire appears within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you like. Each Cube must be contiguous with at least one other Cube. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failed Reaction Roll or half as much damage on a successful one.Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

entries.description: Action: Spend two Fear to exhale fire in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Agility Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take 4d10 fire damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Weakening Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to exhale destructive energy in a cone of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Strength Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail take damage equal to this adversary's standard attack damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Ziraj is a 10th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma. He has the following paladin spells prepared 3st level:
  • Blinding Smite (3rd, Bonus, 1 minute, Evocation, Self) Target hit by the strike takes an extra 3d8 Radiant damage from the attack, and the target has the Blinded condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Blinded target makes a Constitution Reaction Roll, ending the spell on itself on a success.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Ziraj exudes magical menace. Each enemy within 30 feet of him must succeed on a Difficulty (13) Wisdom Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute of Ziraj. If a frightened enemy ends its turn more than 30 feet away from Ziraj, the enemy can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.description: Passive: Zisatta can breathe only underwater.

entries.description: Passive: If Zlan dies within 100 miles of a piece of chardalyn at least 4 inches long, it re-forms from that piece of chardalyn in 1d10 days, regaining all its HP. The new body appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the piece of chardalyn, and another lich's mind in the body seizes psychic control of the body.

entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Zlan casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (19)) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Detect Thoughts (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Divination, Self) Activate one of the effects below. Until the spell ends, you can activate either effect as a Magic action on your later turns. Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of yourself that belong to creatures that know languages or are telepathic. You don't read the thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead. Read Thoughts. Target one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself or one creature within 30 feet of yourself that you detected with the Sense Thoughts option. You learn what is most on the target's mind right now. If the target doesn't know any languages and isn't telepathic, you learn nothing.As a Magic action on your next turn, you can try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, you discern the target's reasoning, emotions, and something that looms large in its mind (such as a worry, love, or hate). On a successful Reaction Roll, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and until you shift your attention away from the target's mind, the target can take an action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC, ending the spell on a success.
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Message (Cantrip, Action, 1 round, Transmutation, 120 feet) Point toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier. Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
2/day:
  • Dimension Door (4th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 500 feet) Teleport to a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction, such as "200 feet straight downward" or "300 feet upward to the northwest at a 45-degree angle."You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.If you, the other creature, or both would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.
  • Fly (3rd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, Touch) Touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.
  • Scrying (5th, 10 Min., Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination, Self) Can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom Reaction Roll, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn't know what it is making the Reaction Roll against, only that it feels uneasy.Your Knowledge of the Target Is...Reaction Roll ModifierSecondhand (heard of the target)+5Firsthand (met the target)+0Extensive (know the target well)-5You Have the Target's...Reaction Roll ModifierPicture or other likeness-2Garment or other possession-4Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail-10On a successful Reaction Roll, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.On a failed Reaction Roll, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.
1/day:
  • Befuddlement (8th, Action, Instantaneous, Enchantment, 150 feet) Blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence Reaction Roll.On a failed Reaction Roll, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell.On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage only.
  • Disintegrate (6th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 60 feet) Launch a green ray at a target you can see within range. The target can be a creature, a non-magical object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by Wall of Force.A creature targeted by this spell makes a Dexterity Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the target takes 10d6 + 40 Force damage. If this damage reduces it to 0 HP, it and everything non-magical it is wearing and carrying are disintegrated into gray dust. The target can be revived only by a True Resurrection or a Wish spell.This spell automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller non-magical object or a creation of magical force. If such a target is Huge or larger, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-Cube portion of it.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to zlan makes one slam or bewildering bolt attack.

entries.description: Reaction: Up to three times in its life, the zodar can cause a message of up to twenty-five words to issue from the air around it. It speaks only when it has something profoundly important to say, and the message can be understood by any creature that has an Intelligence score of 2 or higher.

entries.description: Reaction: If the zodar fails a Reaction Roll, it can choose to succeed instead.

On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage and isn't teleported.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The zodar casts the wish spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17)). After casting this spell, the zodar turns to dust and is destroyed.

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: Reaction: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it must make a Constitution Reaction Roll with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Zombie Plague Spreader

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: Reaction: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it must make a Constitution Reaction Roll with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.name: Viral Aura
entries.description: Reaction: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the plague spreader must make a Difficulty (12) Constitution Reaction Roll. On a failed Reaction Roll, the creature is poisoned and can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature is immune to this plague spreader's Viral Aura for 24 hours.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Virulent Miasma (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability in a emanation of Medium range. All targets within that area must make Finesse Reaction Roll (12). Targets who fail take 4d6 poison damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

motives_tactics: Aid allies, Disrupt enemies, Destroy life, Spread corruption

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If Zorak isn't in sunlight or running water, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form.While in bat form, Zorak can't speak, his walking speed is 5 feet, and he has a flying speed of 30 feet. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with it, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies.While in mist form, Zorak can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has a bonus on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and he is immune to all non-magical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries.description: Passive: Zorak has a bonus on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Zorak fails a Reaction Roll, he can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description: Reaction: When he drops to 0 HP outside his resting place, Zorak transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that he isn't in sunlight or running water. If he can't transform, he is destroyed.While he has 0 HP in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach his resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his resting place, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then paralyzed until he regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in his resting place with 0 HP, he regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Zorak regains 20 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Zorak takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zorak's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Zorak can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries.description: Reaction: Zorak has the following flaws:Forbiddance. Zorak can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.Harmed by Running Water. Zorak takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Zorak's heart while Zorak is incapacitated in his resting place, Zorak is paralyzed until the stake is removed.Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Zorak takes 20 radiant damage when he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has penalty on attack rolls and ability checks

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage.

entries.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Zorak magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Zorak can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Zorak and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Zorak dies, or until Zorak dismisses them as a bonus action.

entries.name: Move
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to zorak moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to zorak makes one unarmed strike.

entries.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to zorak makes one bite attack.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The zorbo has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries.description: Passive: The zorbo magically absorbs the natural strength of its surroundings, adjusting its Armor Class based on the material it is standing or climbing on: AC 15 for wood or bone, AC 17 for earth or stone, or AC 19 for metal. If the zorbo isn't in contact with any of these substances, its AC is 10.

entries.name: Destructive Claws
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target. on a success, the target takes 2d6+1 magic damage.

entries.name: Harass
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to force a PC within Close range to make a test against this adversary's Difficulty or mark a Stress.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Zorhanna Adulare has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Spellcasting

Reaction: Zorhanna Adulare is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (17), +9 to hit with spell attacks). Zorhanna Adulare can cast disguise self and invisibility At will:
  • Light (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Evocation, Touch) Touch one Large or smaller object that isn't being worn or carried by someone else. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like.Covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again.
  • Mage Hand (Cantrip, Action, 1 minute, Conjuration, 30 feet) Spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.When you cast the spell, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial.As a Magic action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet.The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.
  • Prestidigitation (Cantrip, Action, 1 hour, Transmutation, 10 feet) Create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below. If you cast this spell multiple times, you can have up to three of its non-instantaneous effects active at a time. Sensory Effect. You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor. Fire Play. You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. Clean or Soil. You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Minor Sensation. You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour. Magic Mark. You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour. Minor Creation. You create a non-magical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.
  • Shocking Grasp (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, Touch) Lightning springs from you to a creature that you try to touch. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
  • Fire Bolt (Cantrip, Action, Instantaneous, Evocation, 120 feet) Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or an object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell starts burning if it isn't being worn or carried.

9st level:
  • Time Stop (9th, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, Self) Briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.This spell ends if one of the actions you use during this period, or any effects that you create during it, affects a creature other than you or an object being worn or carried by someone other than you. In addition, the spell ends if you move to a place more than 1,000 feet from the location where you cast it.

entries.description: Passive: The simulacrum can't regain expended spell slots or use the properties of the shard solitaire necklace. (The shard solitaire is currently attuned to the Far Realm entity trapped inside.) If the simulacrum drops to 0 HP, it turns to snow and melts away, and the shard solitaire necklace teleports to the safe in Zorhanna's vault tower.

  • Simulacrum (7th, 12 Hr., Until dispelled, Illusion, Touch) Create a simulacrum of one Beast or Humanoid that is within 10 feet of you for the entire casting of the spell. It uses the game statistics of the original creature at the time of casting, except it is a Construct, its Hit Point maximum is half as much, and it can't cast this spell.The simulacrum is Friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn in combat. The simulacrum can't gain levels, and it can't take Short or Long Rests.If the simulacrum takes damage, the only way to restore its HP is to repair it as you take a Long Rest, during which you expend components worth 100 GP per Hit Point restored. The simulacrum must stay within 5 feet of you for the repair.The simulacrum lasts until it drops to 0 HP, at which point it reverts to snow and melts away. entries.name: Battle Command
entries.description: Reaction: As a bonus action, Zress targets one ally he can see within 30 feet of him. If the target can see or hear Zress, the target can use its reaction to make one melee attack or to take the Dodge or Hide action.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries.description: Passive: Zress has a bonus on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Zress to sleep.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description:
Reaction: Zress's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (13)). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components At will:
  • Dancing Lights (Cantrip, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Illusion, 120 feet) Create up to four torch-size lights within range, making them appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs that hover for the duration. Alternatively, you combine the four lights into one glowing Medium form that is vaguely humanlike. Whichever form you choose, each light sheds Dim Light in a 10-foot radius.As a Bonus Action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a space within range. A light must be within 20 feet of another light created by this spell, and a light vanishes if it exceeds the spell's range.
1/day:
  • Darkness (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Evocation, 60 feet) For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and non-magical light can't illuminate it.Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
  • Faerie Fire (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Evocation, 60 feet) Objects in a 20-foot Cube within range are outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Each creature in the Cube is also outlined if it fails a Dexterity Reaction Roll. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.Attack rolls against an affected creature or object have Advantage if the attacker can see it.
  • Levitate (2nd, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Transmutation, 60 feet) One creature or loose object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate an object that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution Reaction Roll is unaffected.The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), which allows it to move as if it were climbing. You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn. If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you can take a Magic action to move the target, which must remain within the spell's range.When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.

entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in sunlight, Zress has penalty on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks. Each attack deals the standard damage (poison).

entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries.description: Reaction: If Zuggtmoy fails a Reaction Roll, she can choose to succeed instead.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: Zuggtmoy has a bonus on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 3 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries.description:
Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Zuggtmoy casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell Reaction Roll Difficulty (22)) At will:
  • Detect Magic (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 10 minutes, Divination (ritual), Self) For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the Magic action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's school of magic.The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
  • Locate Animals or Plants (2nd, Action, Instantaneous, Divination (ritual), Self) Describe or name a specific kind of Beast, Plant creature, or non-magical plant. You learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.
3/day:
  • Dispel Magic (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Abjuration, 120 feet) Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends. For each ongoing spell of level 4 or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (Difficulty (10) plus that spell's level). On a successful check, the spell ends.
  • Entangle (1st, Action, Concentration, up to 1 minute, Conjuration, 90 feet) Grasping plants sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into Difficult Terrain. They disappear when the spell ends.Each creature (other than you) in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends. A Restrained creature can take an action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell Reaction Roll DC. On a success, it frees itself from the grasping plants and is no longer Restrained by them.
  • Plant Growth (3rd, Action, Instantaneous, Transmutation, 150 feet) Channels vitality into plants. The casting time you use determines whether the spell has the Overgrowth or the Enrichment effect below. Overgrowth. Choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through that area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected. Enrichment. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 365 days. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested. They can benefit from only one Plant Growth per year.
1/day:
  • Etherealness (7th, Action, 8 hours, Conjuration, Self) Step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can perceive the plane you left, which looks gray, and you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away.While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by creatures, objects, and effects on that plane. Creatures that aren't on the Ethereal Plane can't perceive or interact with you unless a feature gives them the ability to do so.When the spell ends, you return to the plane you left in the spot that corresponds to your space in the Border Ethereal. If you appear in an occupied space, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.This spell ends instantly if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn't border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.
  • Teleport (7th, Action, Instantaneous, Conjuration, 10 feet) Instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be Large or smaller, and it can't be held or carried by an unwilling creature.The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls 1d100 and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.Teleportation OutcomeFamiliarityMishapSimilar AreaOff TargetOn TargetPermanent circle———01-00Linked object———01-00Very familiar01-0506-1314-2425-00Seen casually01-3334-4344-5354-00Viewed once or described01-4344-5354-7374-00False destination01-5051-00—— Familiarity. Here are the meanings of the terms in the table's Familiarity column:"Permanent circle" means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know."Linked object" means you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard's library."Very familiar" is a place you have visited often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell."Seen casually" is a place you have seen more than once but with which you aren't very familiar."Viewed once or described" is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic, or a place you know through someone else's description, perhaps from a map."False destination" is a place that doesn't exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy's sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a location that no longer exists. Mishap. The spell's unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes 3d10 Force damage, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time). Similar Area. You and your group (or the target object) appear in a different area that's visually or thematically similar to the target area. You appear in the closest similar place. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might appear in another person's laboratory in the same city. Off Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear 2d12 miles away from the destination in a random direction. Roll 1d8 for the direction: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; or 8, northeast. On Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear where you intended.
